title.zh-TW: 多端接手同一個工作階段並肩操作
title.en: Co-drive the same session across devices

body.zh-TW:
你在桌機與終端機之間切換時，想半途插手正在跑的工作階段（AI 對話與任務的執行單位），以前總會被擋在門外。⟦就像裝了雙方向盤的教練車，過去只許一人上車操作，現在多位操作員能同車排隊送出指令，誰先接手就由誰當主駕駛。⟧多個用戶端連上同一台工作階段託管主機時，`session/resume` 會改以共同駕駛身分加入，不再回傳 `sessionInUse`，送出的請求依序執行或依要求插隊替換，並由 `driveHolder` 標出最早的駕駛。透過 `muse serve --listen` 連線時，僅現任駕駛能調整核准模式與權限，其餘連線會收到 `drive_required`，等駕駛斷線即可用 `session/resume` 接管。工作階段探索上限從 64 筆拉高到 128 筆本機與 Claude 紀錄，單機可探索的即時工作階段仍暫限 64 筆。常用指令：

```bash
muse sessions --json          # 列出本機工作階段、開啟者與可否接上
muse sessions --watch --json  # 持續印出工作階段啟動與結束動態
muse attach <session-ref>     # 以第二駕駛接上；無效參考會寫明原因拒絕且不開窗
```
body.en:
When switching between desktop and terminal, trying to step into a running session (the execution unit for AI conversations and tasks) partway through used to lock you out. ⟦A dual-control training car used to let only one person inside to operate it, whereas now multiple operators can ride together and queue commands, with whoever takes over first serving as the main driver.⟧ When multiple clients connect to the same session host, `session/resume` now joins as a co-driver instead of returning `sessionInUse`, submitted requests run in order or cut in to replace as requested, and `driveHolder` marks the earliest driver. When connected via `muse serve --listen`, only the current driver can adjust the approval mode and permissions, while other connections receive `drive_required` and can take over with `session/resume` once the driver disconnects. The session discovery limit increases from 64 to 128 local and Claude records, while discoverable live sessions per machine remain capped at 64 for now. Common commands:

```bash
muse sessions --json          # List local sessions, who opened them, and whether they can be attached
muse sessions --watch --json  # Continuously print session start and end activity
muse attach <session-ref>     # Attach as a second driver; invalid references refuse with the reason and open no window
```

items.original:
`muse sessions --json` lists the sessions running on this machine, with who opened each one and whether it can be attached; `muse sessions --watch --json` keeps printing the list as sessions start and end
Several clients connected to the same session host can now drive one session together: each `session/resume` joins as a co-driver instead of refusing `sessionInUse`, submissions run one at a time in order (a busy submit queues unless it asks to steer or replace), and `driveHolder` names the earliest live driver
`muse attach <session-ref>` opens this terminal attached to a session that is already running, as a second driver on the same timeline; unknown, ambiguous, not-running, and not-attachable references refuse with the reason and open no terminal
On `muse serve --listen`, only the client driving a session can change its approval mode or permission profile; other connected clients get `drive_required` and can take the drive with `session/resume` once the driving client disconnects
Session discovery now lists up to 128 local and Claude sessions, up from 64; each machine still makes at most 64 of its live sessions discoverable until a later release raises that limit

title.zh-TW: 獨立託管工作階段並在連線斷開後持續運作
title.en: Host sessions independently and keep running after disconnect

body.zh-TW:
從本機或 SSH 連接背景主機時，你可能需要輸入結束後仍運作的工作階段（AI 對話的執行單位）。`muse attach --stdio` 會把用戶端的標準輸入與輸出接上持有它的主機，沒有就以指定參數啟動；新啟動的主機不接受 `--trust-workspace`。若被終端機介面、`muse exec` 或舊版佔用，回傳結束碼 4。從該連線另開或分支的工作階段會列入 `muse sessions`，主機仍運作時可連回同一主機。attach 啟動的主機從首次 `session/list` 就會列出該工作階段並附上 `spawnedBy`，即使前主機未完成索引就退出也一樣。

```bash
muse attach --stdio <SESSION_ID> [-- <serve flags>] # 接上或啟動專屬主機，本機與 SSH 皆同
muse serve --per-session # 每條連線開新主機，該主機會列出自己的工作階段，讓另一個用戶端能用 muse attach --stdio <id> 開啟並操作；不接受 --trust-workspace，斷線後持續運作，不送 session/closed，診斷寫入日誌檔
```
body.en:
When connecting to a background host locally or over SSH, you may need a session that keeps running after input ends. `muse attach --stdio` connects the client's standard input and output to the host holding the session, or starts one with the given flags if none exists; a newly started host does not accept `--trust-workspace`. If occupied by a TUI, `muse exec`, or an older version, it returns exit code 4. Sessions opened or forked from that connection are listed in `muse sessions` and can reconnect to the same host while it is still running. A host started by attach lists that session from its first `session/list` with `spawnedBy`, even if the previous host exited before finishing indexing.

```bash
muse attach --stdio <SESSION_ID> [-- <serve flags>] # Attach to or start a dedicated host, same locally and over SSH
muse serve --per-session # Start a new host per connection that lists its sessions so another client can open and operate them with muse attach --stdio <id>; does not accept --trust-workspace, keeps running after disconnect, sends no session/closed, and writes diagnostics to a log file
```

items.original:
`muse attach --stdio <SESSION_ID> [-- <serve flags>]` connects a client's stdin and stdout to the host that holds a session, starting the session's own host with those serve flags when none does (except `--trust-workspace`, which a started host does not take), the same way locally and over ssh; it exits 4 when a TUI, `muse exec` or an older muse already holds the session
`muse serve --per-session` serves each connection from a fresh host of its own, which lists its sessions so another client can open and steer them with `muse attach --stdio <id>`; answers and notifications match plain `muse serve`, except that the host keeps running after your input ends (so no `session/closed` arrives) and its own diagnostics go to a log file instead of stderr; it does not take `--trust-workspace`
A session you fork or start through `muse attach --stdio` beside the one it opened is now listed by `muse sessions` and reopens on the same host with `muse attach --stdio <id>` while that host runs
A host that `muse attach --stdio <id>` starts now lists that session from its first `session/list`, with the session that opened it (`spawnedBy`), even when the session's previous host exited before indexing it

title.zh-TW: 旁觀連線不搶駕駛權也不強行卸載別人對話
title.en: Keep observer connections from taking drive or unloading active chats

body.zh-TW: 多套外掛或介面同時連著同一個工作階段（AI 對話的執行單位）時，只是想查看狀態或退出的連線很容易誤傷正在工作的人。`session/resume` 帶 `admitOnly: true` 只檢查不加入駕駛，不送 `session/driveChanged`，也不重送待核准與待輸入請求；未帶 `admitOnly` 仍會加入駕駛。`muse serve` 中 `session/leave` 離開他人駕駛的對話會回 `sessionInUse`，不卸載。旁觀者呼叫 `turn/unqueue`、`approval/decide` 或 `userInput/*` 結算時，有其他用戶端仍在駕駛就回 `sessionInUse`，並說明如何加入駕駛；無人駕駛時才結算，且不取得駕駛權。查看提示與重播已結算指令仍可用。
body.en: When multiple plugins or interfaces connect to the same session at once, connections that only want to check status or exit can easily disrupt whoever is working. Calling `session/resume` with `admitOnly: true` only checks without joining as a driver, sends no `session/driveChanged`, and does not re-send pending approval or user-input requests; omitting `admitOnly` still joins as a driver. In `muse serve`, calling `session/leave` on a chat driven by someone else returns `sessionInUse` without unloading it. When an observer calls `turn/unqueue`, `approval/decide`, or `userInput/*` to settle, it returns `sessionInUse` and explains how to join as a driver if another client is still driving; it settles only when no one is driving, without taking drive. Viewing prompts and replaying settled commands remain available.

items.original:
Settlement is refused only while a live driver holds the session: an attached observer's `turn/unqueue`, `approval/decide`, and `userInput/*` settlement refuse `sessionInUse` (naming how to join the drivers) while another live driver holds, and settle without taking drive once nobody drives, while observing prompts and replaying settled commands stay available
A `session/resume` check (`admitOnly: true`) no longer makes the checking client a driver of the session, sends `session/driveChanged` (experimental) to its other clients, or re-sends it the session's pending approval and user-input requests; a `session/resume` without `admitOnly` still joins the session's drivers, as before
In `muse serve`, leaving a chat that another connected client is driving no longer stops and unloads it under that client: `session/leave` answers `sessionInUse` and the chat stays loaded

title.zh-TW: 改善連線託管槽位分配與附接錯誤引導
title.en: Improve hosted session slot allocation and attach error guidance

body.zh-TW:
64 個本機槽位只剩 16 個空位時，經 `muse serve --per-session` 開啟或在同一 `muse attach --stdio` 連線另開的工作階段，會停止列入 `muse sessions`，替終端機與 `muse exec` 留位；桌面分頁本身及其分支、側邊對話仍註冊到 64 筆上限。

升級後 `muse attach <session-name>` 會印「indexing session names after an upgrade...」等待索引。從終端機接上 `muse serve` 主機的工作階段時，會立刻告知暫時無法加入、請繼續用原本執行它的視窗，不再跳出恢復清單並誤報已被使用。

這兩種託管主機不再被慢工作階段卡住連線或忽略 `SIGTERM`；若停止曾逾時且最後一名用戶端已離開，停止完成後就退出。放棄慢啟動主機時仍保留啟動日誌。
body.en:
When only 16 of the 64 local slots remain free, sessions opened via `muse serve --per-session` or as additional sessions over the same `muse attach --stdio` connection stop being listed in `muse sessions` to reserve room for terminals and `muse exec`; each Desktop tab's own session, along with its forks and side chats, still registers up to the 64-slot limit.

After an upgrade, `muse attach <session-name>` prints "indexing session names after an upgrade..." while waiting for indexing. When attaching from a terminal to a session on a `muse serve` host, it now immediately reports that it cannot join yet and to keep using the window running it, instead of opening the resume picker and falsely reporting the session as already in use.

Neither type of host is blocked from accepting connections or ignores `SIGTERM` due to a slow session anymore; if a stop timed out and the last client has left, the host exits once the stop finishes. The start log is still kept when giving up on a slow-starting host.

items.original:
A host started by `muse attach --stdio` or `muse serve --per-session` no longer stops taking connections or ignores `SIGTERM` for as long as one of its sessions is slow to respond
With many sessions running in their own processes, new TUI sessions and `muse exec` runs keep local session messaging: once only 16 of the 64 local session slots are free, sessions a program opens through `muse serve --per-session` (or as a further session over one `muse attach --stdio` connection) stop being listed in `muse sessions` instead of taking those slots, while each Desktop tab's own session, and the forks and side chats made on it, still register until all 64 are taken
A host started by `muse attach --stdio` or `muse serve --per-session` whose last client left after a session stop timed out now exits once that stop finishes, instead of staying up until the session is unloaded for being idle
When `muse attach --stdio` gives up on a session host that is slow to start, the start log its error names is kept instead of deleted
Right after an upgrade, `muse attach <session-name>` now waits for the session index to finish reading session names (it prints "indexing session names after an upgrade..." while it waits, as `muse resume <name>` does) instead of refusing that the session-name authority is unavailable; before, every retry refused the same way
`muse attach <session>` from a terminal to a session a `muse serve` host is running now says at once that a terminal can't join it yet and to keep using the window that runs it, instead of opening the resume picker and reporting the session as already in use

title.zh-TW: 從指令列傳訊給執行中的工作階段
title.en: Send messages to running sessions from the command line

body.zh-TW: 讓多個工作階段（AI 對話的執行單位）彼此協作時，過去很難從終端機直接對正在跑的對話傳話。⟦宛如掛在辦公室門口的收件夾，以前忙碌中的窗口進不去，現在從外部或同一間辦公室都能直接遞紙條，簽收目錄還會跟著資料夾一起搬走。⟧現在你能直接從指令列傳訊給執行中的 Muse 工作階段，甚至從工作階段本身發送也可以。當工作階段協定用戶端開啟時，外部送來的訊息會即時抵達，待處理佇列列會顯示寄件者、效果標籤與內文，已送達的訊息則直接進駐對話紀錄。互傳訊息的歷史索引也改存成工作階段資料夾內的檔案，整包複製到另一台電腦就能直接恢復而免去重建。
body.en: When coordinating multiple sessions, it used to be hard to pass a message directly from a terminal to a running conversation. ⟦Picture an inbox hanging on an office door: busy windows used to block anyone from getting in, but now anyone from outside or the same office can slip a note straight through, and the sign-off log moves right along with the folder.⟧ You can now send messages directly from the command line to running Muse sessions, and even from within the session itself. When the session-protocol client is on, incoming messages arrive in real time, pending queue rows show the sender, effect label, and body, and delivered messages appear directly in the transcript. The peer-message history index is now saved as a file inside the session folder, so copying the folder to another machine resumes directly without rebuilding it.

items.original:
Send messages to running Muse sessions from the command line, including from the session itself
A session's peer-message history index is now a file inside the session folder, so a session folder copied to another machine resumes without rebuilding it
Incoming session messages now reach the client when the session protocol client is on: pending queue rows show the sender, effect label, and body, and delivered messages appear in the transcript, matching the classic client

title.zh-TW: 修好跨工作階段傳訊的受理狀態與卡頓
title.en: Fix acceptance status and stalls in cross-session messaging

body.zh-TW:
跨工作階段（AI 對話的執行單位）互相傳訊時，之前在 Linux 上明明送出卻常顯示不確定，傳訊也可能卡住。現在於 Linux 執行 `session-message send`，只要目標工作階段收下訊息就會正確回報成功；從工作階段內部發出的訊息，也會明確標為已受理，不再顯示為未驗證。

在待處理訊息批次裡，送達尚未獲確認的項目仍會保留「已送出」標記，不會回頭被抹掉狀態。現在傳訊不會再被另一個正在更新工作階段清單的對話拖住。
body.en:
When sending messages across sessions, Linux previously often showed an uncertain status even after delivery, and messaging could stall. Running `session-message send` on Linux now properly reports success as soon as the target session accepts the message, and messages sent from inside a session are clearly marked as accepted instead of unverified.

In pending message batches, items whose delivery is not yet confirmed keep their "sent" mark instead of having their status wiped. Sending a message is no longer stalled by another conversation updating the session list.

items.original:
Pending message batches keep sent messages marked as sent when delivery remains unconfirmed
`session-message send` reports success after a Linux session accepts the message
Sending a session message no longer stalls while another session updates the session list
On Linux, messages sent from inside a session now show as accepted instead of unverified

title.zh-TW: 串流旁白即時標記與模型啟動事件
title.en: Stream narration labels in real time and emit model start events

body.zh-TW: 連接工作階段（AI 對話的執行單位）協定的介面，過去常在模型準備動手或工具切換時卡在空白。⟦新聞主播開口就掛上「現場連線」或「結論」字卡，觀眾不用等整段播完才知道內容的性質。⟧現在工具呼叫之間的旁白會像最終回答一樣逐字串流，從第一個字就標明旁白或回答。存檔格式沒變，舊版 Muse 仍能開啟這些對話；忽略標記的用戶端也看不出差別。協定會在聯繫模型供應商前送出 `turn/modelAttemptStarted`，讓介面只於真正運算時顯示思考中。TypeScript SDK 的 `ViewEvent` 與 `StaleDroppableMethod` 加入該事件，逐一比對所有事件種類的程式須新增處理分支。上一回合的後續動作還在等啟動時，排隊提問也會正確回報自己的回合，讓等待該回合的用戶端收到答案。
body.en: Interfaces connected over the session protocol used to get stuck on a blank state while the model prepared to act or switched between tools. ⟦Think of a news anchor putting up a "Live" or "Takeaway" banner the moment they start speaking, so viewers know the nature of the segment without waiting for the whole broadcast to finish.⟧ Narration between tool calls now streams word by word just like final answers, marked as narration or answer from the very first word. The save format is unchanged so older Muse versions can still open these chats, and clients that ignore the mark see no difference. The protocol emits `turn/modelAttemptStarted` before contacting the model provider, allowing interfaces to show thinking only while actual work is underway. In the TypeScript SDK, `ViewEvent` and `StaleDroppableMethod` now include this event, so code that exhaustively matches all event types needs a new case. When a follow-up from the previous turn is still waiting to start, a queued prompt also reports its own turn properly so clients waiting on it receive the answer.

items.original:
Session protocol serves `turn/modelAttemptStarted` each time a model attempt starts, before the provider is contacted, so apps can show the model as thinking only once it is working; in the TypeScript SDK, `ViewEvent` and `StaleDroppableMethod` gain `turn/modelAttemptStarted`, so code that matches them exhaustively needs a new case
Session protocol now streams the model's narration between tool calls as it is written, like final answers; saved chats do not change, so older versions still open them
Session protocol now marks a streaming message as narration or as the answer from its first word, so clients can show narration as narration while it is written; clients that ignore the mark see no change
A prompt queued through the session protocol while a finished turn's follow-up waits to start now reports its own turn, so a client that waits on that turn gets its answer

title.zh-TW: 分支與側邊對話繼承設定並對齊來源標記
title.en: Inherit settings and align origin fields for forks and side chats

body.zh-TW:
從主線分岔出實驗性對話或側邊討論時，過去切換不同視窗打開常會遺失設定甚至開不起來。⟦猶如從盆栽母株剪下一段分株，以前移盆常弄丟配方與名牌，現在不但帶著原本的土壤與養分，來源標籤也寫得清清楚楚。⟧由協定開啟的側邊對話，會完整保留母工作階段（AI 對話的執行單位）的工作區與模型。原本配置的 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）工具也會一併繼承，恢復帶有側邊對話的工作階段不再失敗。分支對話在首回合後會於清單保留資料夾、模型與供應商資訊，在終端機開過的分支也能在所有用戶端順利開啟。來源欄位也已釐清：

```text
forkedFrom.isRewind  # 協定讀取分支時標明是否來自對話倒帶
sideFrom             # 側邊對話的 session/resume 改填此欄，剛開時 session/list 為 null
```
body.en:
When branching off an experimental conversation or side discussion, opening it in a different window used to lose settings or fail to load. ⟦Taking a cutting from a potted mother plant used to mean losing the soil mix and name tag during repotting, whereas now it brings over the original soil and nutrients with a clearly written origin label.⟧ Side chats opened via the protocol keep the parent session's workspace and model intact. Configured MCP (a protocol that connects AI to external tools) tools are inherited as well, and resuming a session with a side chat no longer fails. A forked chat keeps its folder, model, and provider in the list after its first turn, and forks opened in the terminal now load cleanly in all clients. Origin fields have also been clarified:

```text
forkedFrom.isRewind  # Marks whether a forked session read via the protocol came from a conversation rewind
sideFrom             # Populated on session/resume for side chats instead; null in session/list when just opened
```

items.original:
Session protocol reads of a forked session now report whether it came from a conversation rewind (`forkedFrom.isRewind`)
A forked chat that opened in the terminal but failed to load elsewhere now opens in all clients
Side chats opened by session-protocol clients keep the workspace, model and MCP tools of the session they branch from
A forked session keeps its folder, model and provider in the session list after its first turn, instead of being listed with none
Resuming a session with a side chat no longer fails
`session/resume` of a side chat now reports the chat it came from in `sideFrom`, as `session/sideChat` already does, and no longer reports it in `forkedFrom`; `session/list` now reports `sideFrom: null` for a just-opened side chat too, as it already does for every other session

title.zh-TW: 保留託管模型與復原設定並支援單次呼叫
title.en: Preserve hosted model and recovery settings and support one-shot calls

body.zh-TW: 把 Muse 接入外部程式時，你可能只想跑一次生成，也可能希望重開後設定別跑掉。⟦錄音室既能單次試錄、隨時喊卡，長租時調好的音色與備援方案也會留著。⟧透過 `muse serve` 連線的用戶端，不必建立工作階段（AI 對話的執行單位）就能執行單次模型生成並取消。結束後會回傳文字、停止原因、模型名稱與 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）數量。主機會記住啟動或恢復時選定的復原模式，讀取時回報模式與來源；應用或 SDK 指定啟動的模型在清單與重啟後不再跳回預設值。透過協定以 `modelId` 恢復時，也會保存指定模型，如同 `muse resume --model`；若遭主機拒絕，則保留原存模型而不中斷恢復。
body.en: When integrating Muse into external programs, you may want to run a single generation or keep your settings intact after a restart. ⟦Inside a recording studio, you can run a one-off test take and call cut anytime, while keeping your tuned tone and backup plan saved for long-term bookings.⟧ Clients connected through `muse serve` can run a one-shot model generation without creating a session and cancel it. When finished, it returns the text, stop reason, model name, and token (text unit for AI processing and billing) counts. The host remembers the recovery mode chosen when starting or resuming and reports both the mode and its source on read; a model chosen by an app or SDK at launch no longer reverts to the default in session lists or after restarts. Resuming over the protocol with `modelId` also records the specified model just like `muse resume --model`, and if the host refuses it, the session keeps its saved model without failing the resume.

items.original:
Sessions served by `muse serve` now remember the recovery mode a client picks when starting or resuming them, and reading a loaded session reports which mode is in effect and where it came from
`muse serve` clients can run one model completion with no session, cancel it, and get its text, stop reason, model and token counts
Resuming a session over the session protocol with a `modelId` now records that model the way `muse resume --model` does, and a model the host refuses keeps the session on its saved model instead of failing the resume
A session an app or SDK starts with a chosen model keeps that model in session lists and after the host restarts, instead of switching to the host's default model

title.zh-TW: 對齊託管協定的標題、游標與事件順序
title.en: Align titles, cursors, and event order in the hosted protocol

body.zh-TW:
開發工具透過獨立啟動的 `muse serve` 對接時，先前在命名、資料結構與啟動事件順序上和內嵌版有落差。用一般 `session/start` 建立的工作階段（AI 對話的執行單位）現在會自動產生名稱，啟動及首回合後可由 `session/read` 取得；標題則在開啟自動命名時產生。

首次模型回覆前未計價的費用不再送出 `"cost": null`，避免嚴格檢查結構的用戶端拒收；`muse serve --listen` 也會比照標準輸入輸出模式，先送出 `session/started` 通知再回傳 `session/start` 結果。新版檢視游標改為 `v9:` 格式，舊游標會先收到一次「reopen without a cursor」的拒絕提示，舊版檢視快取（暫存紀錄）也會在首次使用時自動重建，不再漏讀或誤讀事件。
body.en:
When developer tools connected via a standalone `muse serve`, there were gaps compared to the embedded version in naming, data structure, and startup event order. Sessions created with a plain `session/start` now generate an automatic name available via `session/read` at start and after the first turn, while titles are generated when automatic naming is enabled.

Unpriced usage before the first model reply no longer sends `"cost": null` so strict schema-checking clients do not reject it, and `muse serve --listen` now matches stdio mode by sending the `session/started` notification before returning the `session/start` result. New view cursors use the `v9:` format, older cursors receive a one-time refusal advising "reopen without a cursor", and older view caches are automatically rebuilt on first use so events are no longer skipped or misread.

items.original:
Session-protocol clients: view cursors are now minted in the `v9:` spelling; a cursor in an older spelling is refused once with the standard "reopen without a cursor" guidance, and a view cache saved by an older build is rebuilt on first use, so no client silently skips or misreads events
Sessions started on standalone `muse serve` with a plain `session/start` now get an automatic name, served on `session/read` at start and after the first turn, like the TUI's embedded host
Standalone `muse serve` generates session titles when automatic naming is on
`muse serve` no longer sends `"cost": null` in a session snapshot's token usage before the first model reply, which made schema-checking clients reject the snapshot; an unpriced cost is now left out, as the protocol schema defines
Apps connected to `muse serve --listen` now get the `session/started` notification before the reply to `session/start`, the same order as over stdio

title.zh-TW: 修復工作階段協定讀取上限與異常提示
title.en: Fix Session Protocol Read Limits and False Error Notices

body.zh-TW:
透過外接應用操作長對話或切換設定時，以前容易讀取失敗或收到假異常通知。超大型工作階段（AI 對話的執行單位）現改用可分頁歷史回傳，不再超出輸出影格上限；正常 `session/leave` 後恢復，也不再誤報上次異常結束。

在 `muse serve` 恢復或分支對話時，原存推理力度 `ultra` 若暫不可用，會先用 `xhigh` 並保留偏好；等 `ultra` 可用才套回，但期間若重設力度，就不再自動套回舊偏好。自 `view/unsubscribe` 後接續讀取不再重送同步抵達的事件，未生效的 hook（特定事件觸發的小程式）阻擋不再顯示為拒絕。IDE 與協定用戶端會在暫停工作流程未存進檢查點時警告，`NoticeOrigin` 加入 `workflowCheckpoint`。
body.en:
When operating long conversations or switching settings through external apps, reads used to fail easily or trigger false error notices. Oversized sessions (the execution units of an AI conversation) now return pageable history so they no longer exceed the outbound frame limit, and resuming after a normal `session/leave` no longer falsely reports that the last run ended abnormally.

When resuming or forking a chat in `muse serve`, if the saved reasoning effort `ultra` is temporarily unavailable, it falls back to `xhigh` while keeping your preference. Once `ultra` becomes available again it is reapplied, unless you reset the effort in the meantime. Resuming reads after `view/unsubscribe` no longer resends events that arrive concurrently, and a block from a hook (a small program triggered by a specific event) that never took effect is no longer shown as a rejection. IDE and protocol clients now warn when a paused workflow is left out of a checkpoint, and `NoticeOrigin` gains `workflowCheckpoint`.

items.original:
Apps connected to Muse Code no longer show a hook that blocked a prompt as a rejection when that block never took effect
Reading a very large session through `muse serve` now returns its details with pageable history instead of failing with "response exceeds the outbound frame limit"
Resuming a chat from a saved position after `view/unsubscribe` no longer sends an event twice when a change lands while the resume is reading history
In `muse serve`, a resumed or forked chat whose saved reasoning effort is `ultra` now runs at `xhigh` while `ultra` is unavailable, as a newly chosen `ultra` already does; the saved choice is kept and applies again once `ultra` is available, unless you set the effort again in the meantime
Over the session protocol, resuming a session that a client had left with `session/leave` no longer reports that its last run ended abnormally
IDE and other session-protocol clients now show the same warning as the terminal when a paused workflow is left out of a saved context checkpoint (`NoticeOrigin` gains `workflowCheckpoint`)

title.zh-TW: TS 與 Python SDK 新增高階單次執行與管理介面
title.en: Add High-Level Single-Turn Run and Management APIs to TS and Python SDKs

body.zh-TW:
寫程式串接 TypeScript 與 Python SDK 管理工作階段（AI 對話的執行單位）時，過去常得自己拼湊繁瑣的底層協定指令。⟦好比把裸露的電路板裝進標好按鈕的遙控器，現在按一個鍵就能跑完一輪對話並取回答案與用量。⟧新版 SDK 與教學文件改推高階介面，能列出任務、技能與 hook（特定事件觸發的小程式），暫停或恢復工作流程、取得回顧、送回饋、開側邊對話及搜尋已存工作階段。未傳入主機路徑時 `spawn` 會自動搜尋 `PATH` 並於找不到時列出搜尋路徑，偶有未封裝的指令也可改用 `client.command` 發送，但會擋下由 SDK 自行管理的指令。原文明確點名的高階介面包括：

```text
session.run                     # 單次呼叫跑完一回合，支援取消並回傳答案、項目與 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）用量
MuseClient.spawn / startSession # 快速入門與食譜範例改教這些高階操作
```
body.en:
When writing code against the TypeScript and Python SDKs to manage sessions, you previously had to assemble tedious low-level protocol commands by hand. ⟦Like housing an exposed circuit board inside a remote with labeled buttons, the SDKs now let a single key press run a full conversation turn and bring back the answer and usage.⟧ The updated SDKs and docs now center on high-level interfaces that can list tasks, skills, and hooks, pause or resume workflows, request a recap, submit feedback, open a side chat, and search stored sessions. When no host path is passed, `spawn` automatically searches `PATH` and lists the searched paths if none is found, while any unwrapped commands can still be sent via `client.command`, which blocks commands managed by the SDK itself. High-level interfaces explicitly named in the original notes include:

```text
session.run                     # Run a full turn in one call, supporting cancellation and returning the answer, items, and token (text units AI processes and bills by) usage
MuseClient.spawn / startSession # Quickstart and cookbook examples now teach these high-level operations
```

items.original:
The TypeScript and Python SDKs can now list a session's tasks, skills, and hooks, pause and resume workflows, request a recap, submit feedback, open a side chat, and search stored sessions without raw protocol calls
The TypeScript and Python SDK clients can send protocol commands the SDK does not wrap yet with `client.command`, which refuses the commands the SDK manages itself
The TypeScript and Python SDKs can now run a turn in one call with `session.run`, which returns the final answer text, the turn's items, and its token usage, and stops the turn on an abort signal or task cancellation
The TypeScript and Python SDKs find `muse` on `PATH` when you do not pass a host path to `spawn`, and say what they searched when no host is found
The TypeScript and Python SDK quickstart and cookbook recipes now teach the high-level client (`MuseClient.spawn`, `startSession`, `session.run`, `turn.cancel()`, `setModel`, `listModels`) instead of raw session protocol calls

title.zh-TW: 修好 SDK 撤回佇列、中止執行與指紋比對
title.en: Fix SDK Queue Reclaim, Run Cancellation, and Schema Fingerprinting

body.zh-TW:
用 TypeScript 或 Python SDK 控制忙碌中的主機時，先前若在排隊中途喊停，常出現草稿取不回或指令依然偷跑的狀況。現在於排隊且主機忙碌時中止 `Session.run`，SDK 會在背景持續把該回合撤回而不會照跑，Python 版若再次取消更能立刻返回並讓撤回繼續完成。

不論伺服器回覆順序為何，`turn.unqueue` 現在一定會交還成功收回的佇列草稿。恢復工作階段（AI 對話的執行單位）後，已結束回合的提問不再被列為待回答，在原始碼目錄內匯入 Python SDK 也會穩定使用套件封裝內的結構指紋，不再誤抓開發中的即時結構。
body.en:
When controlling a busy host with the TypeScript or Python SDK, stopping a queued run mid-way used to leave the draft unreturned or let the command run anyway. Now, aborting `Session.run` while its turn is queued and the host is busy keeps the SDK pulling that turn back in the background so it does not run, and cancelling again in Python returns immediately while the take-back finishes.

Regardless of the order server replies arrive in, `turn.unqueue` now always returns the queued draft it reclaimed. After resuming a session, questions from already-finished turns are no longer listed as waiting for an answer, and importing the Python SDK from inside a source checkout reliably uses the bundled package schema fingerprint instead of picking up the live in-development schema.

items.original:
The SDKs no longer list a question from a turn that already finished as still waiting for an answer after a resume
In the TypeScript and Python SDKs, `turn.unqueue()` now always hands back the queued draft it reclaimed, whatever order the server's replies arrive in
The Python SDK now derives its schema fingerprint from its wheel's bundled schema when imported from inside a source checkout, instead of the checkout's live schema
Aborting `Session.run` in the TypeScript and Python SDKs while its turn is still queued and the host is busy now keeps taking the turn back, so the turn no longer runs after the abort; in Python, cancelling again returns at once while the take-back still finishes

title.zh-TW: 用終端機指令直接管理與登入 MCP 伺服器
title.en: Manage and Sign In to MCP Servers Directly from the Terminal

body.zh-TW:
平時想讓 AI 接上各種外部工具，不用再手動翻找與編輯設定檔裡的欄位了。⟦恰似替手機通訊錄補齊增刪查按鈕，以前得手動翻進設定檔修改格式，現在直接在終端機下指令就能把外部工具記進名冊或撤除。⟧現在這組管理 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器的指令已完整就緒，同時支援寫入個人使用者設定或專案設定檔，也修好了全新設定檔剛加入第一台伺服器後 `muse mcp login` 失敗的問題。常用管理指令如下：

```bash
muse mcp list      # 列出已設定的伺服器、來源、傳輸方式與登入狀態
muse mcp get       # 檢視單一伺服器的來源、傳輸方式與登入細節
muse mcp add       # 新增 MCP 伺服器到個人或專案設定
muse mcp add-json  # 直接以 JSON 格式寫入伺服器設定
muse mcp remove    # 從個人或專案設定移除伺服器
muse mcp login     # 替新增的伺服器進行登入驗證
```
body.en:
To connect AI to external tools, you no longer have to dig through and edit configuration fields by hand. ⟦Just as giving a phone's contacts app add, delete, and search buttons saves you from editing raw files, terminal commands now let you register or remove external tools directly.⟧ This full set of commands for managing MCP (a protocol that connects AI to external tools) servers is now ready, supporting both personal user settings and project config files, and fixing a bug where `muse mcp login` failed right after adding the first server to a fresh config. Common management commands include:

```bash
muse mcp list      # List configured servers, their source, transport, and sign-in status
muse mcp get       # View a single server's source, transport, and sign-in details
muse mcp add       # Add an MCP server to personal or project settings
muse mcp add-json  # Write a server config directly in JSON format
muse mcp remove    # Remove a server from personal or project settings
muse mcp login     # Authenticate a newly added server
```

items.original:
`muse mcp list` and `muse mcp get` show configured MCP servers with their source, transport, and sign-in status
`muse mcp add` and `muse mcp add-json` save MCP servers to user settings or the project file
`muse mcp remove` deletes MCP servers from user settings or the project file
`muse mcp login` works after adding the first server to a fresh config

title.zh-TW: MCP 連線代理設定、呼叫提示與報錯點名
title.en: MCP Proxy Settings, Running Call Hints, and Specific Error Reporting

body.zh-TW:
在需要透過代理伺服器連網的公司環境，或排查 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）設定錯誤時，以前常只看到空白或模糊失敗。現在執行中的呼叫會直接顯示正在跑的 MCP 工具與伺服器名稱，而 MCP 伺服器與 hook（特定事件觸發的小程式）也會像其他程式一樣吃到網路代理設定。

查詢指令的診斷也更精準：當儲存庫標記無法讀取時，會直接報錯而不再悄悄略過專案伺服器；格式錯誤會點名出問題的專案檔案並正確區分非檔案路徑；純文字模式的失敗輸出也會像 `--json` 一樣先印出待處理警告再列錯誤。代理變數包含：

```bash
HTTP_PROXY   # HTTP 代理設定
HTTPS_PROXY  # HTTPS 代理設定
ALL_PROXY    # 通用代理設定
NO_PROXY     # 略過代理的例外清單
```
body.en:
In corporate networks that require a proxy server, or when troubleshooting MCP configuration errors, you used to see only blank output or vague failures. Running calls now directly display the active MCP tool and server names, and MCP servers and hooks pick up network proxy settings just like other apps.

Query command diagnostics are also sharper: when repository markers cannot be read, an error is reported instead of silently skipping project servers; format errors name the exact project file at fault and properly classify non-file paths; and plain-text failure output now prints pending warnings before the error line, matching `--json`. Proxy variables include:

```bash
HTTP_PROXY   # HTTP proxy setting
HTTPS_PROXY  # HTTPS proxy setting
ALL_PROXY    # General proxy setting
NO_PROXY     # Exception list to bypass the proxy
```

items.original:
MCP servers and hooks now get your proxy settings (`HTTP_PROXY`, `HTTPS_PROXY`, `ALL_PROXY` and `NO_PROXY`), as other apps do
Show MCP tool and server names while a call is running
`muse mcp get` and `muse mcp list` text failures now print the pending MCP warnings ahead of the error line, matching the `--json` stderr behavior
`muse mcp list` and `muse mcp get` fault reports now name the exact project file at fault and classify non-file settings paths correctly
`muse mcp list` and `muse mcp get` report an error when repository markers cannot be read instead of silently omitting project servers

title.zh-TW: 協定層追蹤子代理派工與多層巢狀關聯
title.en: Track Subagent Dispatch and Multi-Level Nesting in the Session Protocol

body.zh-TW:
當主對話同時派工給多位子代理、甚至子代理底下又繼續往下派工時，外接介面先前只能從雜亂的訊息流裡硬湊關係。⟦好比拆分成多層子母單的快遞物流，過去所有派件全塞在總訂單底下，現在每張包裹都印著上游託運人與簽收時間，重整畫面也照原順序排好。⟧透過 `muse serve` 連線的用戶端，現在能直接查詢工作階段（AI 對話的執行單位）裡執行中與已結束的子代理清單，取得 ID、定義檔路徑、父層、狀態與結果是否就緒。協定項目也補齊關鍵標記：

```text
ItemKind: subagentInput        # 記錄送給子代理每筆輸入的排隊與送達時間，結果附帶接續列位，讓用戶端恢復工作階段時能照紀錄順序顯示這些列
deliveredBeforeTurnEnd: true   # 標示子代理於父回合結束前已收下該筆輸入，恢復時可區分中斷或完成
parentSubagentId               # 標記發起該子代理的上層子代理，讓巢狀子代理歸位不掛回根對話
```
body.en:
When a main conversation dispatches work to multiple subagents—or even when subagents delegate further down—external interfaces previously had to piece relationships together from a tangled message stream. ⟦Much like express shipping split into multi-level master and child waybills, where dispatches used to pile under one main order, each parcel now carries its upstream shipper and sign-off time so a screen refresh keeps the original order.⟧ Clients connected via `muse serve` can now directly query the list of running and finished subagents in a session, getting their IDs, definition paths, parent, state, and result readiness. Protocol items also gain key markers:

```text
ItemKind: subagentInput        # Records when each input sent to a subagent was queued and delivered, with the result naming the row it follows so clients can display rows in record order on resume
deliveredBeforeTurnEnd: true   # Marks that the subagent received the input before its parent's turn ended, distinguishing interrupted turns from finished ones on resume
parentSubagentId               # Identifies the upstream subagent that spawned this one, filing nested subagents under their parent instead of the root session
```

items.original:
`ItemKind` gains `subagentInput` — session-protocol clients get one item for each input a session sent to a subagent, when it was queued and when it was delivered, and a delivered subagent result names the row its Finished marker follows, so a client can show those rows in record order on resume
A client connected to `muse serve` over the session protocol can now list a session's subagents (running and finished) with ids, definition paths, parent, state, and result readiness, instead of parsing parent-stream child records
Session protocol: a delivered subagent input item now carries `deliveredBeforeTurnEnd: true` when the subagent took that input before its parent's turn ended, so a client resuming the session can tell an interrupted turn from a finished one
A session protocol `subagent` item now names the subagent whose own session spawned it (`parentSubagentId`), so a client can file a nested subagent under its parent instead of under the root session

title.zh-TW: 子代理停止控制生效並回報確切拒絕原因
title.en: Enforce Subagent Stop Controls and Report Exact Refusal Reasons

body.zh-TW:
要緊急叫停跑偏的子代理或它底下的孫代理時，以前常喊了停卻沒停下來，或只得到一句含糊的拒絕。現在透過 `muse serve` 與 SDK 要求停止由另一名子代理啟動的下屬，或是直接在子代理對話串裡輸入 `/stop all` 停掉它自己開出的子代理，都能真正切斷執行而不報失敗；對已送出其他訊息的子代理下停止指令，也會實際終止運作而非只貼取消標籤。

在 `muse serve` 遭到拒絕的操作（中斷、停止、恢復、重開或關閉）也不再只回籠統錯誤，而是會點名確切原因，例如 `owner_not_running` 或 `attempt_history_unavailable`。

停止已經停下的子代理則會回傳 `subagent_already_stopped`，不再誤給 `subagent_state_ineligible`，讓用戶端能分辨這是剛好已經停了，而不是停止失敗。
body.en:
When urgently stopping a stray subagent or its own subagents, stop commands used to fail to halt execution or return only a vague refusal. Now, requesting through `muse serve` and the SDKs to stop a subordinate started by another subagent, or typing `/stop all` directly in a subagent's thread to stop its own subagents, actually terminates execution without failing; issuing a stop after sending another message to a subagent also ends its running work instead of merely marking it cancelled.

Requests refused by `muse serve` (to interrupt, stop, resume, reopen, or close) no longer return a generic error, and instead name the exact reason, such as `owner_not_running` or `attempt_history_unavailable`.

Stopping a subagent that has already stopped now returns `subagent_already_stopped` instead of `subagent_state_ineligible`, letting clients tell that race apart from a failed stop.

items.original:
When `muse serve` refuses a request to interrupt, stop, resume, reopen or close a subagent, the refusal now names the exact reason (for example `owner_not_running` or `attempt_history_unavailable`) instead of one general reason
Through `muse serve` and the SDKs, stopping a subagent that has already stopped now answers `subagent_already_stopped` instead of `subagent_state_ineligible`, so a client can tell that race from a failed stop
Stopping a subagent after another message now ends its running work instead of only marking it cancelled
Through `muse serve` and the SDKs, stopping a subagent that another subagent started now stops it instead of failing
`/stop all` in a subagent's thread now stops that subagent's own running subagents instead of reporting the stop as failed

title.zh-TW: 子代理完整交卷並減少無謂回報與重覆派工
title.en: Deliver Full Subagent Results and Cut Redundant Polling and Reports

body.zh-TW:
主代理把長研究交給子代理執行時，先前只要結果超過 512 個字元，主代理還得另外派一位讀取員去翻後半段，或一直開新監看員輪詢。⟦如同接手調查的組員寫完長報告，主管不用再派人去抄寫或頻頻開會，直接去指定檔案櫃就能讀完整份內容。⟧現在子代理主動交卷時會附上完整答案的位置而非只給前 512 字元，指導準則也要求主代理自行讀取截斷內容、輪詢長等待時不再每輪生新監看員，沒有新進度就保持安靜。

代理卡片現在會顯示工具呼叫總數，復原後的子檢視在明確讀取後也會展示保留結果而非空白，子代理在逼近步數上限前亦會收到繳交結果的提醒。
body.en:
When a parent agent handed off long research to a subagent, any result over 512 characters used to force the parent to spawn a separate reader for the rest or keep launching new watchers to poll. ⟦When a team member finishes a long investigation report, the manager no longer needs to send someone to copy it or hold frequent check-ins, and can simply read the full document from the designated filing cabinet.⟧ Now, when a subagent delivers its result on its own, it includes where to read the whole answer rather than only the first 512 characters, and subagent guidance instructs the parent to fetch truncated answers itself, poll long waits without spawning a fresh watcher per round, and stay silent when there is nothing new to report.

Agent cards now display the total number of tool calls, a recovered child view shows its retained result after an explicit result read instead of an empty slot, and subagents receive a reminder to submit required results before hitting their step limit.

items.original:
When a subagent's result arrives on its own while the parent agent is doing other work, the parent is now told where to read the subagent's whole answer instead of only its first 512 characters
A recovered subagent's child view now shows its retained result after an explicit result read instead of an empty result slot
Subagent guidance now tells the parent agent to fetch a truncated child answer itself instead of spawning a reader, to poll long waits without a fresh watcher subagent per round, and to stay silent instead of posting a status update every time a subagent returns with nothing new to report
Agent cards show the total number of tool calls
Subagents are reminded to submit required results before reaching their step limit

title.zh-TW: 修復子代理於壓縮後失聯與恢復衝突
title.en: Fix Subagent Disconnects After Compaction and Resume Conflicts

body.zh-TW:
當主對話已經做過上下文壓縮，或背景任務與子代理同時在重啟後恢復執行時，子代理先前很容易失聯或反覆被喚醒。現在父對話壓縮過後再傳訊給子代理不會再失敗；恢復運作的子代理回合也會先等背景喚醒與壓縮安裝跑完才上場，不再搶在旁邊阻擋檢查點存檔。

對子代理的工作階段（AI 對話的執行單位）呼叫 `session/read` 時，若父層早先已讀過異動，就不會再把已送達輸入標在佇列裡。對應的 worktree（讓專案平行開多份副本的功能）也不會繼續誤顯為 `active`。當無法復原執行時重試子代理會回傳已存的建立結果，中斷過的這類子代理也不會再因背景指令結束而報錯或反覆醒來。
body.en:
When the main conversation had already gone through context compaction, or when background tasks and subagents resumed together after a restart, subagents used to lose contact or wake up repeatedly. Now, sending a message to a subagent after the parent conversation is compacted no longer fails, and a resumed subagent turn waits for any background task wake or compaction install to finish before running instead of blocking compaction checkpoints alongside it.

Calling `session/read` on a subagent's session no longer keeps a delivered input marked as queued if the parent already read the change earlier. Its corresponding worktree (a feature for opening multiple parallel copies of a project) also stops staying marked as `active`. Retrying a subagent when execution recovery is unavailable returns the saved creation result, and interrupted subagents no longer fail or wake repeatedly when background commands finish.

items.original:
`session/read` on a subagent's session no longer keeps showing its worktree as `active`, or a delivered input as queued, when the parent recorded the change during an earlier read
A resumed subagent's turn now waits until a background task wake or a compaction install in its session finishes, instead of running beside it where compaction checkpoints were refused
Fixed subagents failing when receiving a message after the parent conversation was compacted
Subagent retries return the saved creation result when execution recovery is unavailable
Prevent interrupted subagents from failing or repeatedly waking when background commands finish

title.zh-TW: 子代理跨回合與重開後的進度紀錄一致
title.en: Keep Subagent Progress Consistent Across Turns and Reopened Chats

body.zh-TW:
中斷再重開有子代理參與的長對話時，以前檢視畫面常會漏掉舊紀錄、把失敗看成完成，或重複跳出完工通知。現在恢復壓縮過的工作階段（AI 對話的執行單位）時會把檢查點前已完成的子代理整齊還原，重開對話也會保留子代理的停止資訊，不會再重複送出完成訊息或把新的子工作誤標成已完成。

子代理檢視跨越多個父回合時活動順序不再錯亂，取消或失敗的嘗試也不會再寫著 Result ready；透過 `muse serve` 與 SDK 恢復被中斷的子代理時，新回合運作期間不會誤貼上一輪遲來的結果。耗盡提醒卻沒交答案的恢復子代理，也會明確回報缺少答案，不再交回看似成功的空白結果。
body.en:
When interrupting and reopening a long conversation involving subagents, the view used to drop old records, show failures as finished, or repeat completion notices. Now, resuming a compacted session cleanly restores subagents that finished before the checkpoint, and reopening a chat preserves subagent Stop information without repeating completion messages or marking new child work as finished.

A subagent's view keeps its activity in order across multiple parent turns, and cancelled or failed attempts no longer read Result ready; when resuming an interrupted subagent through `muse serve` and the SDKs, a late result from the previous run is no longer shown while the new run is working. A resumed subagent that exhausts its reminders without submitting an answer now explicitly reports a missing answer instead of returning an empty success.

items.original:
Resumed subagents report a missing answer instead of empty success after exhausting their reminders
A subagent's view keeps its activity in order across parent turns, and a cancelled or failed attempt's result row no longer reads Result ready
Resuming a compacted session restores subagents that finished before the checkpoint instead of dropping their rows
Resuming a chat no longer repeats subagent completion messages or shows new child work as finished
Through `muse serve` and the SDKs, a subagent that was interrupted and resumed no longer shows its earlier run's late result as its own while the new run is working
Preserve subagent Stop information when reopening a chat

title.zh-TW: 工作流程讀寫完整報告並依原順序編號
title.en: Workflows Read and Write Complete Reports in Original Order

body.zh-TW:
啟動多代理協作的工作流程進行研究與彙整時，各個成員交回的龐大報告以前常在半路被截短或編號亂掉。⟦好比雜誌編輯台彙整專題稿件，過去只取前幾段又按交稿先後亂排，現在全員完整文稿都留存齊全，並按企劃原本大綱依序編號。⟧現在工作流程能從已完成工作的代理（流程中負責執行任務的單元）讀取完整結果，研究型工作流程在驗證與報告統整階段也能持續使用大型完整結果；子代理後續補件後，先前產出的結果不會被覆蓋遺失。

在 `muse serve` 工作階段（AI 對話的執行單位）協定裡，已結束的工作流程會依照自身定義的順序而非啟動順序排列代理，讓各介面編號一致；工作流程對子代理讀取先前報告與引述報告欄位的指引也已釐清，要求逐字引用前先解碼、保留字面跳脫字元並將評論寫在引號外。
body.en:
When you launch a multi-agent workflow for research and synthesis, bulky reports turned in by members used to get truncated midway or misnumbered. ⟦Magazine editors compiling a special feature used to keep only the opening paragraphs and stack articles in whatever order they arrived; now every contributor's full draft stays intact and is numbered by the original outline.⟧ Workflows can now read complete results from finished agents (units that execute tasks within a workflow), and research workflows can also keep using large complete results through verification and report synthesis. Earlier results are no longer overwritten and lost after a subagent sends a follow-up.

In the `muse serve` session (the execution unit of an AI conversation) protocol, a finished workflow now lists its agents in the workflow's own order rather than the order they started, so every client numbers them the same way. Guidance for workflow children reading prior reports and quoting report fields has also been clarified, requiring them to decode fields before quoting verbatim, keep literal escapes, and place commentary outside the quotes.

items.original:
Clarified instructions for reading prior reports in Workflow children
Workflows can read complete results from finished workers
In the `muse serve` session protocol, a finished workflow now lists its agents in the workflow's own order rather than the order they started, so every client numbers them the same way
Research workflows use complete large results through verification and report synthesis
Workflow reports retain earlier results after a subagent follow-up
Clarify guidance to decode Workflow report fields before quoting them verbatim, keep literal escapes, and place commentary outside the quote

title.zh-TW: 工作流程強化容錯重試與結算狀態回報
title.en: Workflows Strengthen Fault-Tolerant Retries and Settlement Reporting

body.zh-TW:
多代理工作流程在即將收尾或遇到短暫硬碟錯誤時，以前常因為一次小擦傷就整串判死。現在腳本本身已經跑完卻在彙整摘要時短暫讀取紀錄失敗，會先自動重試一會兒，持續失敗才會寫明無法讀取紀錄；工作流程腳本即使內部處理掉單一失敗的代理呼叫而順利收尾，Muse 也不再誤告訴主對話的 AI 代理工作流程失敗，所以它不會再把已完成的工作流程說成失敗。

當其中一位代理無法確認啟動已存檔（例如磁碟空間已滿）時，先前遺漏的失敗通知已補回，其餘代理也會照常跑完而不被連坐停掉。工作階段（AI 對話的執行單位）的儲存錯誤排除後，已結束代理結算時不再跳回排程或執行中，腳本也能完整保留含部分狀態與剩餘工作的回傳值。
body.en:
When a multi-agent workflow was wrapping up or hit a brief disk error, a single minor hiccup used to fail the whole chain. Now, if a script has already finished but hits a brief record-read failure while building its summary, it automatically retries for a short while and only fails with a message stating its records could not be read if the read keeps failing. Even when a workflow script handles a single failed agent call internally and finishes cleanly, Muse no longer mistakenly tells the main conversation's AI agent that the workflow failed, so it no longer reports a finished workflow as failed.

When one agent cannot confirm that its start was saved (for example, because the disk is full), previously missing failure notifications are restored, and the remaining agents keep running as normal instead of being stopped with it. Once a session storage error clears, finished agents no longer revert to scheduled or running when settling, and scripts preserve their complete return value, including partial status and remaining work.

items.original:
A Workflow whose script already finished no longer fails because one read of its records failed briefly while its final summary was being built; it retries for a short while, and a read that keeps failing fails the Workflow with a reason saying its records could not be read
When one agent in a Workflow cannot confirm that its start was saved (for example, because the disk is full), the Workflow's other agents now keep running instead of being stopped
Restore missing Workflow failure notifications when a child start cannot be confirmed
When a Workflow finishes after its script handled a failed agent call, Muse no longer tells the agent that the Workflow failed, so the agent no longer reports a finished Workflow as failed
After a session storage error clears, a Workflow agent that already finished no longer shows as scheduled or running again when the Workflow settles
Workflow scripts preserve their complete return value, including partial status and remaining work

title.zh-TW: 長時運行工作流程突破檢查點上限且壓縮不遺失
title.en: Long-Running Workflows Lift Checkpoint Limits Without Losing Compacted Turns

body.zh-TW:
長時間反覆執行工作流程時，舊檢查點背著所有已結束流程的子代，累計約 2,000 個就無法存檔。⟦學生上學不必天天背已結業的兩千張舊考卷，只帶當下需要的課本，書包拉鍊才不會撐壞。⟧現在已結束工作流程的子代不再寫進新檢查點，再對該子代派工會說明流程已結束；恢復長對話後，同一父層下的新代理也不得重用早已結束工作流程的子代名稱（兩種紀錄皆須新版程式才能開啟）。

重開壓縮過的對話不再丟失已完成的工作流程回合；暫停工作流程後壓縮仍能運作，即便尚未寫過工作階段（AI 對話的執行單位）檢查點便壓縮，重啟後仍可恢復，若無法存進上下文則會明講僅限本次恢復；容量紀錄遺失啟動紀錄時，僅該工作流程的子代無法在重啟後恢復，對話照常存檔。
body.en:
During long sessions running workflows repeatedly, old checkpoints carried every child of ended workflows until saving failed at around 2,000 children. ⟦Students do not need to haul two thousand graded exams from past terms to school every day—carrying only today's textbooks keeps the backpack zipper from bursting.⟧ Children of ended workflows are no longer written to new checkpoints, and assigning work to such a child now explains that the workflow has ended. After resuming a long chat, new agents under the same parent can no longer reuse the name of a child from a long-finished workflow (both types of records require a newer app version to open).

Reopening a compacted chat no longer drops completed workflow turns. Compaction still works after pausing a workflow, and even if compaction happens before any session checkpoint is written, it remains resumable after a restart—or, if it cannot be saved in the context, Muse explicitly states it can only be resumed in this session. When a capacity record loses its launch record, only that workflow's children cannot resume after a restart, while the chat keeps saving as usual.

items.original:
Long sessions that run Workflows nonstop keep saving their resume checkpoints. A checkpoint no longer keeps every finished child of a Workflow that has ended, which grew it until saving failed after about 2,000 children. Asking a child of a long-finished Workflow for more work now explains that the Workflow has ended. Opening a session compacted this way needs this app version or later
After resuming a long session, a new agent can no longer reuse the name of a child from a long-finished Workflow under the same parent. Before, the resumed session allowed the name while the full session history refused it. Opening a session that holds such a name needs this app version or later
Reopening a chat no longer drops completed workflow turns after compaction
After you pause a workflow, later context compactions keep working instead of failing every time; if a paused workflow can't be kept in the saved context, Muse tells you it can still be resumed in this session but not after a restart
A paused workflow now stays resumable after Muse restarts even when a context compaction happens before any session checkpoint
A session running Workflows no longer gets stuck unable to save its context when a Workflow capacity record has lost its launch record; that one Workflow can no longer resume its children after a restart, and the session keeps saving and continuing

title.zh-TW: 工作流程中斷復原保留成果並說明重跑細節
title.en: Interrupted Workflow Recovery Preserves Results and Explains Reruns

body.zh-TW:
程式意外重啟或把執行一半的工作流程暫停下來，以前常卡在任務歷史錯誤或得整批重跑。現在用 `muse workflows recover --apply` 復原或接續在 Muse Code 1.4.5 及更早版本中斷的工作流程時，會留住已跑完的代理呼叫，只從頭重跑當時仍在跑的項目，並標出各自使用的模型；暫停前已完成的結果與停止狀態在重啟後也會妥善保留。

任務歷史錯誤與在首次送出模型請求前就中斷的重試問題都已排除，重啟後可直接續跑；若因某位代理的啟動紀錄損壞導致復原喊停，結果與 Latest error 列都會直接列出白話原因與下一步處理方式，不再只丟出錯誤代碼。
body.en:
When the app restarted unexpectedly or you paused a mid-run workflow, recovery used to stall on task-history errors or force a full rerun. Now, when you use `muse workflows recover --apply` to recover or resume a workflow interrupted in Muse Code 1.4.5 or earlier, finished agent calls are kept, only items that were still running are rerun from the start with each rerun's model noted, and results completed before a pause plus any stopped state are preserved across restarts.

Both the task-history error and retries interrupted before their first model request have been resolved so they can continue right after a restart. If recovery halts because an agent's start record is damaged, both the result and the Latest error row now state the plain reason and next step instead of throwing only an error code.

items.original:
Recovering (`muse workflows recover --apply`) or resuming a workflow interrupted on Muse Code 1.4.5 or earlier keeps its finished agent calls, reruns the ones that were still running from the start, and says which model each rerun used
Fixed a task-history error that could prevent interrupted Workflows from resuming after a restart
Resumed workflow reports retain results completed before the pause
Workflow retries that had started but were interrupted before their first model request now continue after a restart instead of being held back
Stopping a paused workflow now still reports the stop after Muse restarts
A Workflow resume that stops because an agent's saved start record is damaged now reports the plain reason and next step in its result and in the Latest error row, not only an error code

title.zh-TW: 工作流程收尾不卡住其他工作階段喚醒
title.en: Workflow Completion No Longer Blocks Other Session Wake-Ups

body.zh-TW:
工作流程底下有個別代理結束或卡住時，以前常連帶讓整個對話的鬧鐘與背景通知全部失靈。現在工作流程成員完工後，背景任務結果、定時報到與監看事件仍會正常喚醒閒置工作階段（AI 對話的執行單位）。若單一成員的結果暫時無法領取，才只有該成員的更新先等待，父對話與其他工作階段仍會照常被喚醒。

執行中的工作流程成員也不再於回合還沒跑完時被塞入背景指令提醒，避免它們半路被打岔而沒能送出結果；恢復暫停中的工作流程時，先前已完成的子代成果同樣會完整留下。
body.en:
When an individual agent in a workflow finished or got stuck, it used to knock out alarms and background notifications for the entire conversation. Now, after a workflow member finishes, background task results, scheduled check-ins, and watcher events still wake an idle session normally. If a single member's results are temporarily unclaimable, only that member's update waits, while the parent conversation and other sessions still wake as usual.

Running workflow members also no longer have background-command reminders queued before their turn finishes, preventing them from being interrupted mid-turn and failing to submit results. When resuming a paused workflow, previously completed child results are also kept intact.

items.original:
Background task results, scheduled check-ins and watcher events no longer stop waking an idle session after a workflow worker finishes
When one Workflow worker's results can't be claimed, background updates for every other session, its parent included, still wake an idle session; only that worker's update waits
Workflow workers no longer get a background-command reminder queued while their turn is still running, which could stop them from submitting their result
Resume paused Workflows while preserving completed child results

title.zh-TW: 新增 /cron 排程管理並改善目標暫停與準點喚醒
title.en: Added /cron Management and Improved Goal Pausing and On-Time Wake-Ups

body.zh-TW: 把長期目標或定時檢查交給 AI 接手時，過去最怕不知它何時設了排程、或按 Esc 暫停後忘記怎麼叫醒。⟦好似替長時間燉煮設好明確鬧鐘，過去只能不斷探頭掀鍋蓋，現在隨時看得到剩餘安排與清單，時間一到還會準點響鈴。⟧現在代理建立目標或排程任務時會主動留下通知，輸入 `/cron` 即可列出與刪除排程；當目標等待工作階段外某個已知結束時間的條件（如壓力測試或冷卻時間）時，代理會直接排定該時刻剛過後的單次喚醒，不再只按延後提醒。在日光節約時間結束出現重複一小時的時段，每小時或更頻繁的排程提示也會兩輪照常觸發，按 Esc 暫停目標時更會強化提示、於狀態列與下則訊息後的提醒寫出 `/goal resume`，輸入 `/goal` 則列出可用指令。
body.en: Handing a long-term goal or scheduled check to the AI used to leave you guessing when a job was set or how to wake it after pressing Esc to pause. ⟦Setting a clear timer for a slow simmer beats lifting the pot lid every few minutes—you can check the remaining schedule anytime and hear the bell right on cue.⟧ The agent now leaves a notice when creating a goal or scheduled job, and entering `/cron` lists or removes scheduled jobs. When a goal waits on an external condition with a known end time (such as a stress test or cooldown), the agent schedules a one-time wake-up just after that time instead of only snoozing. During the repeated hour when daylight saving time ends, hourly or faster scheduled prompts still fire on both passes, while pressing Esc to pause a goal now highlights the pause notice, names `/goal resume` in the status bar and in a reminder after your next message, and `/goal` lists available commands.

items.original:
The agent now leaves a notice when it creates a goal or a cron job for you, and `/cron` lists and removes your scheduled jobs
When Esc pauses a goal, the pause notice now stands out, the status bar and one reminder after your next message name `/goal resume`, and `/goal` lists the commands you can use
While a goal waits on something outside the session that ends at a known time, such as a soak or a cooldown, the agent schedules a one-time wake-up for just after that time instead of only snoozing
Scheduled prompts with an hourly or faster cadence now fire during both passes of the repeated hour when daylight saving time ends, instead of skipping the second pass

title.zh-TW: 修好 /goal 恢復啟動與進度提醒計數
title.en: Fixed /goal Resume Startup and Progress Reminder Counting

body.zh-TW:
長程執行的 `/goal` 目標模式之前常在恢復與自主推進時「表面寫著運作中、實際上卻一動也不動」。現在不論是在回合或 `!shell` 指令執行中，還是目標提醒剛暫停目標的瞬間輸入 `/goal resume`，都會確實觸發恢復回合；若該回合最終無法啟動，終端機也會將目標切回暫停狀態，好讓你再次輸入 `/goal resume`。

啟動中的 `/goal` 遇到沒有接續推進的回覆後會繼續自主執行，不再乾等你的下一則訊息；恢復目標回合後才來的背景任務結果也會乖乖排進下一回合，不再併行搶跑而拒絕壓縮檢查點。進度提醒也修正為每呼叫模型一次計一次，按原設計在約 30 次沒有回報進度後才提醒，不再於約 15 次就提前跳出。
body.en:
Long-running `/goal` mode previously often looked active on the surface while doing nothing during resumes or autonomous progress. Now, entering `/goal resume` during a running turn or `!shell` command, or right as the goal reminder pauses the goal, reliably starts the resumed turn; if that turn ultimately fails to start, the terminal switches the goal back to paused so you can enter `/goal resume` again.

An active `/goal` keeps working on its own after a reply that did not advance it instead of waiting idle for your next message, and background task results arriving after a resumed goal turn wait for the next turn rather than running concurrently and refusing compaction checkpoints. Progress reminders are also fixed to count once per model call, firing after about 30 calls without reported progress as designed instead of popping up early at around 15.

items.original:
`/goal resume` now starts the resumed turn when it is sent while a turn or a `!shell` is running, or at the moment the goal reminder pauses the goal; before, the goal could show as active while nothing ran
An active `/goal` keeps working on its own after a reply that did not continue it, instead of waiting for you to send another message
`/goal resume` in the terminal now puts the goal back to paused when the resumed turn then fails to start for good, so another `/goal resume` can start it; before, the goal could show as active while nothing ran
When a finished background task wakes the agent after a resumed goal turn, its result now waits for the next turn instead of running beside it, which refused compaction checkpoints
While `/goal` works on its own, a progress reminder now comes after about 30 model calls without reported progress, as designed, instead of about 15, because each call is counted once

title.zh-TW: 目標模式搭配監看與對話壓縮不再卡死
title.en: Goal Mode No Longer Stalls with Watchers or Chat Compaction

body.zh-TW:
開啟 `/goal` 目標模式執行長任務時，只要同時碰到背景監看、壓縮對話或工作流程，以前常把目標卡在半路動彈不得。現在目標提醒啟動中若只剩長任務的監看結果待等，代理會結束當前回合交給監看通知喚醒，不再空轉輪詢；由代理自己停掉或檢查時已確認結束的背景指令，也不再被誤算成還在跑，好讓提醒能叫回代理繼續處理未完工作。

在與儲存和壓縮的配合上，即便壓縮遺留了暫停中的工作流程，目標復原功能依然可用；目標回合結束時若工作流程仍在跑並在稍後完工，工作階段（AI 對話的執行單位）也不再漏存壓縮檢查點，而壓縮進行中暫停或編輯目標也能完整保留恢復點。
body.en:
When running long tasks in `/goal` mode, combining background watchers, chat compaction, or workflows used to leave the goal stuck midway. Now, while a goal reminder is active and only a long job's watcher result remains, the agent ends the current turn to let the watcher notification wake it instead of polling in a loop; background commands the agent stopped itself or saw finish while checking are no longer counted as still running, so reminders can bring the agent back to unfinished work.

On the storage and compaction side, Goal recovery stays usable even if compaction leaves behind a paused workflow. When a Goal turn ends while a workflow is still running and finishes later, the session no longer skips saving its compaction checkpoint, and pausing or editing a goal during compaction preserves its resume point.

items.original:
With a goal reminder active, when the only thing left is the result of a watcher the agent started on a long job, the turn now ends instead of the agent polling; the watcher's notice wakes the agent to finish
Keep Goal recovery usable when compaction leaves a paused workflow behind
With a goal reminder active, a background command the agent stopped itself (or saw finish while checking on it) no longer counts as still running, so the reminder can send the agent back to unfinished work instead of leaving the session idle with nothing left to wake it
A session no longer skips a compaction checkpoint when a Goal turn ended while its Workflow kept running and later finished
In a long `/goal` session, pausing, editing or otherwise changing the goal while Muse compacts the conversation no longer leaves that compaction without a resume point

title.zh-TW: 隱藏目標提示不外洩並防範損壞提醒阻礙對話
title.en: Hidden Goal Prompts Stay Private and Broken Reminders No Longer Block Chats

body.zh-TW:
翻找過去用 `/goal` 跑過的對話，或工作階段（AI 對話的執行單位）帶著壞掉的排程與提醒紀錄重啟時，以前常看到一堆系統內部字樣，甚至整段對話打不開。現在用 `/goal` 開啟的工作階段在 `/resume` 清單與各應用中，會改顯示你的第一句提問（未輸入前不設標題），預覽畫面也不再把隱藏的目標提示誤當成你發的訊息。

啟動時若發現某則提醒指定的工具不存在或工具 token（語法記號）格式錯誤，TUI 與 `tbh exec` 會停用該提醒並點名問題與修法，而 `tbh serve` 下目前僅靜默停用。提醒清單跨重啟遺失仍可重開對話，載入時若隔離了損壞的排程資料庫，也會透過 `session/resume` 顯示一次警告列。
body.en:
When browsing past `/goal` chats or restarting a session with broken cron and reminder records, internal system text used to show up or keep the entire chat from opening. Sessions started with `/goal` now display your first prompt (or no title until you enter one) in the `/resume` list and across apps, and previews no longer mistake hidden goal prompts for your messages.

If startup finds a reminder naming a nonexistent tool or a malformed tool token (syntax unit), the TUI and `tbh exec` disable that reminder while naming the issue and how to fix it, whereas `tbh serve` currently disables it silently. Chats still reopen if the reminder list is lost across a restart, and if loading quarantines a corrupt cron database, `session/resume` displays a warning row once.

items.original:
A reminder whose duty names a tool that does not exist, or has a malformed tool token, is now turned off when the session starts, with a notice in the TUI and in `tbh exec` output that names the reminder and the token and says how to fix it, instead of failing silently each time it would run (under `tbh serve` it is turned off without a notice for now)
A resume whose load quarantines a corrupt cron database now reports it on `session/resume`, so the client shows the warning row once
A session started with `/goal` is no longer named after Muse's hidden goal instructions in `/resume` and in apps that list your sessions; it shows your first prompt, or no title until you send one
The `/resume` preview of a session a `/goal` drove no longer shows Muse's hidden goal prompts as your messages
A session whose reminder list was lost across a restart now reopens instead of refusing every turn

title.zh-TW: 未信任工作區停用 MCP 並收緊沙盒與寫入核准
title.en: Untrusted Workspaces Disable MCP and Tighten Sandbox and Write Approvals

body.zh-TW:
來路不明的專案，先把關再放行。⟦如同進入沒確認屋主的倉庫，先斷外接工具電源，你簽了字才准寫備忘。⟧未信任的工作區，所有 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器都不會啟動，專案設定不讀不列並顯示受擋數量與原因，`/mcp` 標記為「withheld: workspace untrusted」。信任該工作區後，下個工作階段才啟動它們。寫入記憶前須先出示內容徵詢核准。

在 `muse serve` 裡，子代理與工作流程改沿用母工作階段（AI 對話的執行單位）的核准模式：全部允許的工作階段不再為子代理跳詢問，未匹配規則就拒絕的工作階段，工作流程代理直接拒絕不詢問。

指令請求跨出沙盒（隔離執行環境）時，可選擇在該工作區永遠允許該指令，但舊版無法恢復顯示過此選項的對話；Windows 沙盒啟動時先說明兩個本機帳號用途並問 Yes 或 No，選 No 不動任何設定直接退出。
body.en:
For projects of unknown origin, vet first and allow later. ⟦Entering a warehouse with an unverified owner means cutting power to external tools first and only jotting down notes after you sign off.⟧ In an untrusted workspace, no MCP (Model Context Protocol, a standard for connecting AI to external tools) servers start, project configs are neither read nor listed while showing the withheld count and reason, and `/mcp` marks them as "withheld: workspace untrusted". After you trust the workspace, they start on the next session. Before writing to memory, the agent must show the contents and ask for approval.

In `muse serve`, subagents and workflow agents now inherit the parent session's approval mode: allow-all sessions no longer prompt for subagents, and in deny-unmatched sessions, workflow agents deny directly without asking.

When a command asks to run outside the sandbox (isolated execution environment), you can choose to always allow it in that workspace, though older versions cannot resume a session that showed this option; Windows sandbox setup at startup first explains the purpose of two local accounts and asks Yes or No, exiting without changing any settings if you choose No.

items.original:
When a command asks to run outside the sandbox, its approval prompt now offers "Always allow outside the sandbox in this workspace" for that command, so later runs of it there skip the prompt; an older Muse version can't resume a session that showed this choice until it updates
Automatic Windows sandbox setup at startup now first explains the two local Windows accounts it creates or updates and what each one runs, then asks Yes or No; No exits without changing anything
Security: In `muse serve`, subagents and workflow agents now use the same approval mode as the session that started them, so an allow-all session no longer prompts for its subagents and a deny-unmatched session's workflow agents deny instead of asking
Security: Sessions in workspaces the user has not trusted no longer start any MCP servers. Startup withholds every configured server, shows one notice naming the withheld count and reason (project-scope servers are withheld unread, without being listed), and `/mcp` marks each knowable withheld server as "withheld: workspace untrusted". Trusting the workspace starts them on the next session
Security: In an untrusted workspace, the agent now asks for approval before writing to memory, showing what it wants to save, instead of running silently

title.zh-TW: 堵住沙盒網路導向漏洞並先問再查網域
title.en: Close Sandbox Network Redirect Flaws and Ask Before Domain Lookups

body.zh-TW: 在沙盒（隔離執行環境）裡執行指令，過去連線前就先偷查網域，並行指令也有被改道本機服務的風險。⟦比方社區訪客須先取得住戶點頭，大廳才幫忙撥內線查門牌，不讓外人趁亂探聽或掉包連線目標。⟧現在連向新主機必先核准才查網域，不存在的主機名稱亦同，僅 `localhost` 會先驗證是否指向本機。Linux 沙盒也堵住將自己或並行指令的連線重導至其他本機服務的漏洞。`shell` 參數現限用 bash、zsh 或 sh，Windows 限 PowerShell 或 pwsh，其餘改用預設 shell。這樣核准過的指令一定跑在你預期的 shell 裡。同工作區或工作階段（AI 對話的執行單位）裡多個沙盒同時進出時，不再隨機報錯 "Can't find source path"。連帶觸發的 hook（特定事件觸發的小程式）在並行啟停時也一併修好。
body.en: Commands running in a sandbox (an isolated execution environment) used to look up domains secretly before connecting, and concurrent commands risked being redirected to local services. ⟦Visitors to a gated community must get a resident's nod before the front desk dials the intercom to check a unit number, keeping outsiders from snooping or swapping the destination.⟧ Now any connection to a new host requires your approval before looking up its domain, including hostnames that do not exist; only `localhost` is checked first to confirm it points to this machine. The Linux sandbox also closes the loophole that let a command redirect its own or a concurrent command's connection to another local service. The `shell` argument now accepts only bash, zsh, or sh, or PowerShell or pwsh on Windows, while any other value falls back to the default shell. That ensures an approved command always runs in the shell you expect. Multiple sandboxes entering or exiting at the same time in the same workspace or session (an execution unit of an AI conversation) no longer fail at random with "Can't find source path". Any hook (a small program triggered by specific events) fired alongside them is fixed for concurrent starts and stops as well.

items.original:
Security: Sandboxed Linux commands can no longer redirect their own approved network connections to a different local service than the one you approved
Security: Sandboxed Linux commands can no longer redirect another concurrent command's approved network connections to a different local service than the one you approved
Security: When a command running in the sandbox asks to reach a new host, Muse now asks for your approval before looking the hostname up, so a declined host is not looked up; only `localhost` names are still looked up first, to confirm they point at this computer, and a hostname that does not exist now also asks for approval before it fails
Security: A tool call's `shell` argument can now select only bash, zsh or sh (PowerShell or pwsh on Windows); any other value runs the default shell, so an approved command always runs under a shell you expect
Sandboxed commands and hooks no longer fail at random with "Can't find source path" while another sandboxed process in the same workspace exits
Sandboxed hooks and commands no longer fail at random with "Can't find source path" when another sandboxed process in the same session starts or exits

title.zh-TW: 防範設定與登入憑證遭改寫、旁路窺探或塞爆
title.en: Protect Settings and Sign-In Credentials From Overwrites, Side-Channel Reads, or Oversized Files

body.zh-TW:
存放帳號登入細節與軟體偏好的資料夾，最怕被指令繞道偷看、誤改或遭超大檔案撐爆。⟦彷彿替存放證件的保險櫃封死所有牆後暗門與過大郵包，從側邊走廊繞道或硬塞都會被門鎖擋下。⟧現在在 `muse serve` 託管的工作階段（AI 對話的執行單位）中執行 `!` shell 指令，再也無法寫入存放用戶端憑證與設定的資料夾。

在 Linux 上，沙盒（隔離執行環境）指令與檔案工具無法再透過第二掛載點讀取 `~/.config/muse` 等設定資料夾，包括 WSL 的 `/mnt/wslg/distro` 與額外繫結的家目錄；在這類機器上，更新前啟動的子代理在 `/resume` 後可能會失去工作工具，掃描第二掛載點的指令則會回報這些資料夾無法讀取。超過 16 MiB 的設定、憑證與信任檔也會直接報錯拒讀，不再整份載入記憶體。
body.en:
Folders holding account sign-in details and app preferences are vulnerable to commands peeking through side paths, overwriting them, or overloading them with huge files. ⟦Sealing every hidden door behind a document safe and blocking oversized parcels stops anyone from sneaking in through a side corridor or forcing too much inside.⟧ Now a `!` shell command run in a session hosted by `muse serve` can no longer write to the folders where client credentials and settings live.

On Linux, sandboxed commands and file tools can no longer read settings folders such as `~/.config/muse` through a second mount point, including WSL's `/mnt/wslg/distro` and extra bind-mounted home directories; on those machines, a subagent started before updating may lose its work tools after `/resume`, and commands walking the second mount report those folders as unreadable. Settings, credential, and trust files larger than 16 MiB are also rejected with an error instead of being loaded whole into memory.

items.original:
Security: A `!` shell command run in a session that `muse serve` hosts can no longer write the folders where Muse keeps its client credentials and settings
Security: On Linux, sandboxed commands and file tools can no longer read sign-in details or settings in `~/.config/muse` and the other settings folders through a second mount of the same filesystem, such as WSL's `/mnt/wslg/distro` or a home folder bind-mounted at a second path; on such a computer a subagent started before updating can lose its work tools when it continues after `/resume`, and a command that walks that second mount reports the settings folders inside it as unreadable
Settings, credential, and trust files larger than 16 MiB are now refused with an error instead of being read into memory whole

title.zh-TW: 嚴格驗證共用電腦上的工作階段啟動路徑與權限
title.en: Strictly Verify Session Startup Paths and Permissions on Shared Computers

body.zh-TW:
在多人共用的電腦上啟動獨立託管時，如果上層資料夾或連結歸別人管，對方就有機會暗中調包資料夾或連結。⟦想像在共用宿舍寄放重要工具箱，不只要鎖好箱子，連走廊門把歸誰、信封封條有沒有被動過都要先逐一查驗。⟧現在只要本機工作階段（AI 對話的執行單位）註冊資料夾或專屬主機啟動資料夾的上層目錄屬於其他本機使用者，Muse 就拒絕信任；經由他人擁有的多層資料夾連結也不會啟動主機。

資料夾路徑過長時，`muse attach --stdio` 與 `muse serve --per-session` 只會在 `/tmp/tbh-<uid>-rt` 確實屬於你、權限為 0700 且非連結時（缺少時自動建立）才於該處啟動，否則停下並說明修法；寫入後遭變動的啟動檔同樣一律拒用。
body.en:
When starting an isolated host on a shared computer, if a parent folder or link belongs to someone else, they could secretly swap out the folder or link. ⟦Storing a vital toolbox in a shared dorm means more than locking the box—you also check who owns the hallway doorknob and whether the envelope seal was tampered with.⟧ Now Muse refuses to trust its local session registry folder or a session host's startup folder whenever a parent directory is owned by another local user, and it will not start a host through multi-layer folder links owned by someone else.

When a folder path is too long, `muse attach --stdio` and `muse serve --per-session` start under `/tmp/tbh-<uid>-rt` only if it is owned by you, has mode 0700, and is not a link (creating it automatically if missing), otherwise stopping with instructions on how to fix it; any startup file altered after being written is also refused.

items.original:
Security: Muse no longer trusts its local session registry folder, or the startup folder of a session's own host, when it sits inside a folder another local user owns; that user could swap in folders of their own, and on a shared Mac change what is inside through folder settings
Security: A session's own host no longer starts through a folder link that another local user owns, even one reached through another link, since they could swap the link and move the host's files
Security: When your data folder's path is too long for its own socket, `muse attach --stdio` and `muse serve --per-session` now start their host under `/tmp/tbh-<uid>-rt` only when that folder is yours, mode 0700, and not a link (they create it when it is missing); otherwise they stop with an error that says how to fix it
Security: A host that `muse attach --stdio` or `muse serve --per-session` starts now refuses a startup file that something changed after it was written, so another session cannot alter what the host starts with

title.zh-TW: 加強金鑰自動遮罩並保留一般名詞討論
title.en: Strengthen Automatic Secret Redaction While Preserving Plain-Text Mentions

body.zh-TW: 送出錯誤回報或讓 AI 讀系統錯誤時，最怕把真密碼連帶上傳，卻又怕過度敏感把正常文字塗得面目全非。⟦宛如報社編輯把照片裡的真實卡號整串塗黑，卻不會連文章裡寫著「信用卡」三個字也一併剪掉，既防外洩又不誤傷溝通。⟧現在出現在 `Bearer` 或 `Authorization: token`（授權令牌）後方的 Meta API 金鑰，會從模型視野、工作階段日誌與錯誤輸出中整組隱藏；但在回答或工具結果裡純粹提到 `"JWT bearer tokens"` 等字詞時，會原樣保留給模型，不再誤貼遮罩標記讓模型抄進程式碼。使用 `/feedback` 上傳前，備註、近期活動、當機報告、畫面與設定快照裡的連線字串密碼、驗證標頭、JWT、常見金鑰，以及 `token:` 或 `password:` 後方的文字都會自動遮成 `[REDACTED]`。
body.en: When sending error reports or letting AI read system errors, the big risk is uploading real passwords—yet being overly sensitive can blot out normal text beyond recognition. ⟦Newsroom editors black out a real card number in a photo without cutting the words "credit card" out of the article, preventing leaks while keeping communication intact.⟧ Now a Meta API key after `Bearer` or `Authorization: token` (an authorization credential) is hidden whole from the model's view, session logs, and error output, while plain mentions like `"JWT bearer tokens"` in answers or tool results reach the model unchanged instead of inserting a redaction marker it might copy into code. Before `/feedback` uploads anything, connection-string passwords, authorization headers, JWTs, common keys, and text following `token:` or `password:` in your note, recent activity, crash reports, screen snapshot, and configuration snapshot are automatically masked as `[REDACTED]`.

items.original:
Security: A Meta API key after `Bearer` or `Authorization: token`, such as in a printed `curl -H` command or a provider error, is now hidden whole from the model, session logs and error output
Security: `/feedback` now removes more kinds of secrets, such as passwords in connection strings, authorization headers, JWTs and common API key formats, from your note, the recent activity, crash reports, the screen snapshot and the configuration snapshot before upload. Text that follows a secret-looking label, such as `token:` or `password:`, is hidden too, so a note titled "Auth token: refresh loop" is filed as "Auth token: [REDACTED]"
Answers and other tool results that mention bearer tokens in plain words, such as "JWT bearer tokens", now reach the model unchanged instead of showing a redaction marker the model could copy into code; real bearer credentials are still hidden

title.zh-TW: 背景長任務改為靜候自動回報，停止空轉輪詢
title.en: Wait Quietly for Automatic Reports on Long Background Tasks Instead of Polling

body.zh-TW: 以前讓 AI 在背景跑編譯或測試這類耗時指令時，它常會急著一再檢查進度，有時甚至卡著等上五分鐘卻錯過完工通知，白白燒掉好幾輪對話回合。⟦如同把衣服丟進洗衣機就先忙別的事，不再站在門前反覆檢查轉完沒，等結束鈴響了再回來收衣服。⟧現在只要場上只剩代理自己啟動的背景工作，它就會直接結束當前回合，把剩下的交給完成或卡住通知自動喚醒；背景狀態回報也會主動提醒「結果會自動送達」，讓代理不再用新 shell 指令去翻日誌或查行程，真要盯進度就改用 `Monitor` 工具。就算背景任務中途只報一聲「還在跑」，代理也會安靜結束這次檢查，不再多耗一次模型呼叫去寫摘要。
