body.en: Previously, when you had AI run a slow command like a build or test in the background, it would often keep checking progress impatiently, sometimes stalling for up to five minutes and missing the finish notice while wasting several conversation turns. ⟦Tossing laundry into the washing machine lets you get on with other chores instead of standing at the door checking if the spin is done, coming back only when the chime rings.⟧ Now whenever the only work left is a background job the agent started, it ends the current turn and lets the completion or stuck-job notice wake it automatically; background status results also remind it that the result arrives automatically, so it stops spawning new shell commands to check logs or processes and uses the `Monitor` tool if it actually needs to watch progress. Even when a background task wakes the agent just to report that it is still running, the agent ends that check quietly instead of spending an extra model call on a summary.

items.original:
When the only thing left is a background job the agent started, the turn now ends instead of the agent polling it; the job's completion or stuck-job notice wakes the agent to finish
Background work status results now tell the agent that completion arrives automatically, so it stops repeatedly checking status while a long command runs and waits for the delivered result instead
Background work waits no longer loop on repeated status checks that burn turns
After starting a long command in the background, the agent ends its turn and reports the result when it finishes, instead of sometimes waiting up to five minutes and missing the finish
While a long command runs in the background, Muse no longer keeps re-checking its log file or process from new shell calls; it ends the turn for the automatic result or watches progress with the `Monitor` tool
When a long-running background task wakes the agent only to report that it is still running, the agent now ends that check quietly instead of making an extra model call to write a summary

title.zh-TW: 暫停等待的對話在任務完工時立刻恢復
title.en: Resume Parked Conversations Immediately When Tasks Finish

body.zh-TW: 先前交給監看器或背景指令等結果時，對話常停在「Working」一動也不動，或者結果其實早就到了卻卡住好幾個小時，非得你主動按一下鍵盤或傳句話才肯往下跑。現在不論是用一般路徑或正規 `Monitor` 路徑啟動的監看器出現變動列、監看任務結束，還是背景工作跑完，暫停等待的工作階段（AI 對話的執行單位）都會立刻恢復並由代理接手處理。對話閒置期間排隊等待的背景任務結果與監看事件，也會直接送達，不再乾等你的下一次按鍵。
body.en: Previously, when waiting on a watcher or background command for results, a conversation could stay stuck on "Working" or leave arrived results stranded for hours until you pressed a key or sent a message. Now a parked session resumes immediately and hands control back to the agent whenever a watcher started through either the standard path or the canonical `Monitor` path emits change lines, a watch task ends, or a background job finishes. Background-task results and monitor events queued while the chat sits idle are also delivered directly instead of waiting for your next keypress.

items.original:
A session parked waiting on watched external work now resumes when a watcher change event or a background task completion arrives, instead of staying on Working until interrupted
A session parked waiting on a Monitor watcher now resumes on that watcher's change lines even when the watcher was started by the canonical Monitor path, instead of staying parked until interrupted
A session that paused to wait now resumes when its background task finishes instead of staying stuck until you intervene
Agent acts on a finished background task instead of waiting for the next message
A parked run resumes when the watcher task it waits on finishes
Background-task results and monitor events queued while the chat sits idle are delivered without waiting for your next keypress; a parked end-of-turn wait no longer strands them for hours

title.zh-TW: 背景喚醒與執行中回合不再搶道或提早中斷
title.en: Prevent Background Wakes and Active Turns From Colliding or Stopping Early

body.zh-TW:
先前多個背景通知和進行中的回合交錯時，容易出現兩個回合同時並跑而擋掉壓縮檢查點，或是長任務才剛說完「接下來要做什麼」就突然停下來。現在背景任務完成喚醒代理時，會先妥善結束原本的等待回合，絕不另開第二回合並跑；回合輪詢中的長指令跑完後會繼續往下做，已結束的 shell 指令也不再阻礙長任務推進。

至於在回合尾聲進入等待的工作階段（AI 對話的執行單位），只要收到失敗的背景指令或剛進入等待前才抵達的跨對話訊息，就會正確喚醒而不再死停在 Working；但如果是該回合裡早已讀過的他方訊息，就不會再讓等待提前結束。
body.en:
Previously, when multiple background notices crossed paths with an active turn, two turns could run side by side and block compaction checkpoints, or a long task could stop abruptly right after announcing its next step. Now when a finished background task wakes the agent, the waiting turn ends cleanly first so a second turn never runs alongside it; a turn polling a long command keeps working after the command finishes, and already-finished shell commands no longer block long tasks from continuing.

For a session waiting at the end of a turn, receiving a failed background command or a cross-session message that arrived just before waiting began now wakes it properly instead of leaving it stuck on Working, whereas a message from another session that it already read during that turn no longer cuts the wait short.

items.original:
A turn keeps working after a long-running command it was polling completes
A finished background task no longer starts a second agent turn beside one that is still working, which refused compaction checkpoints
When a finished background task wakes the agent, the waiting turn now ends first, so it cannot resume beside the new turn and block its checkpoints
Long tasks no longer stop early after announcing the next step; shell commands that already finished no longer block the agent from continuing
A session waiting at the end of a turn now wakes when a result arrives that would wake an idle session, such as a failed background command or a message another session sent to wake it, including one that arrived just before it began waiting for background work, instead of staying on Working until you type
A session waiting at the end of a turn no longer stops waiting early because of a message from another session that it already read during that turn

title.zh-TW: 補齊背景等待中斷、長輸出頭尾與卡住追蹤
title.en: Fix Background Wait Interruptions, Long Output Heads and Tails, and Stall Tracking

body.zh-TW:
背景等待出狀況或你想中途喊卡時，以前常找不到線索或被空白通知卡住倒帶。現在取消或插隊調整正在外部等待的執行流程，會直接走取消或取代出口而不報錯或照常恢復；空白的背景通知也不會再多生出無意義回合或擋住倒帶功能。

若代理在閒置時遺失喚醒訊號，阻塞解除後排程與背景喚醒會自動重新排隊；排隊背景工作啟動失敗則會寫進 `/feedback` 本機診斷與全螢幕外的終端機。代理查看執行中指令的過長輸出時，會同時拿到開頭、最新輸出與中間略過的位元組數。若背景通知持續遭拒醒，存檔也會記下是哪個阻擋鎖拒收以便追蹤，但含此紀錄的工作階段（AI 對話的執行單位）須更新程式才能開啟。
body.en:
When a background wait ran into trouble or you tried to call it off mid-way, clues were hard to find and empty notices could block rewind. Now cancelling or steering a run sitting on an external wait takes the cancel or supersede exit directly instead of reporting an error or resuming normally, and empty background notifications no longer add pointless turns or block rewind.

If the agent misses a wake-up signal while idle, scheduled and background wakes automatically re-queue once the blocking state clears; when queued background work fails to start, the failure is written to the local diagnostics sent by `/feedback` and to the terminal outside the full-screen view. When the agent checks a running command whose output is too long, it now receives both the start and the newest output along with the count of bytes skipped in between. If a background notice keeps being refused its wake-up, the saved session records which hold refused it for easier tracing, though a session containing this note requires updating the app to open.

items.original:
When a waiting background notice keeps being refused its wake-up, the saved session now notes which hold refused it, so a stalled helper can be traced; an older Muse build cannot open a session holding this note, so update the app to open it (other sessions are unaffected)
Cancelling or steering a run waiting on a covered external wait now takes the cancel or supersede exit instead of reporting an error or resuming
Scheduled and background wakes queued while the agent is idle no longer wait for your next message after a lost wake-up signal — the runtime re-queues the wake itself once the blocking state clears
Prevent empty background notifications from adding turns or blocking rewind
When the agent checks on a command that is still running and the new output is longer than it asked to see, it now gets the newest output as well as the start, with a line counting the bytes left out between them, instead of only the oldest part
When queued background work cannot be started, the failure is now written to the local diagnostics that `/feedback` sends, and to the terminal outside the full-screen view, instead of being silently dropped

title.zh-TW: Monitor 監看器保留最新輸出與真實停止原因
title.en: Preserve Latest Output and Real Stop Reasons for Monitor Watchers

body.zh-TW:
用 `Monitor` 監看背景流程時，以前中斷重連、當機或倒帶，常弄丟尾端畫面與停止原因。⟦機台黑盒子在斷電重開後留下最後讀數，超時或斷線停機也有紀錄，不再只見停機卻不知原因。⟧恢復工作階段（AI 對話的執行單位）的快照現在附上各 `Monitor` 最近輸出，恢復後馬上看得到，不再是空白。

監看器因雜訊、逾時或串流關閉而自停，會記下原因；遲來更新不蓋掉停止標籤，倒帶後也仍綁定原工作階段。當機恢復後，孤立的背景監看呼叫改標「Review … unresolved」並保留耗時。若監看器剛好在當機前結束，子代理先前回合中的該監看器會顯示自身記錄的結束狀態（`ended`、`timed out` 或失敗原因），而非 `stopped`。
body.en:
When watching background processes with `Monitor`, disconnects, crashes, or rewinds used to drop the tail output and stop reason. ⟦An industrial black box keeps its final readings after a power cut and logs whether a timeout or severed line halted the machine, so you never see a stoppage without a cause.⟧ A resumed session's snapshot now includes each `Monitor`'s recent output lines so they appear immediately after resuming instead of showing up blank.

A monitor that stops itself due to noise, a timeout, or a closed stream now records the reason; late updates do not overwrite its stopped label, and its status stays tied to the source session after a rewind. After a crash and resume, orphaned background monitor calls are revised to "Review … unresolved" while keeping their duration stamp. When a monitor finished just before a crash, a subagent's earlier turns show the monitor's own recorded end state (`ended`, `timed out`, or the failure reason) instead of `stopped`.

items.original:
A resumed session's snapshot now carries each Monitor's recent output lines, including the ones already delivered to the model, so a client shows the Monitor's tail right after resuming instead of an empty one
Late background updates keep stopped Monitors labeled as stopped
A monitor that stops itself for noise, timeout, or a closed stream now always records its stop reason in the session
After a crash and resume, orphaned background monitor calls now revise to "Review … unresolved" like other orphaned tools instead of keeping their pre-crash settled text, and the revised row keeps its duration stamp
Keep Monitor stop status tied to its source session after a rewind
After a crash, a subagent's earlier turns show a monitor's own recorded end (ended, timed out, or failed with its reason) instead of `stopped` when the monitor finished just before the crash

title.zh-TW: 外部誤刪或調包對話紀錄檔時立即鎖定保護
title.en: Lock Down Protection Immediately When Conversation Logs Are Deleted or Replaced Externally

body.zh-TW: 有人或同步工具在 Muse 執行時刪除、替換或移走工作階段（AI 對話的執行單位）紀錄，以前可能讓它默默開新檔或寫進替代檔。⟦會計遇到帳本被調包會停筆示警；只有原本只是被移走，放回原處才可接續記帳。⟧紀錄遭刪除或替換時，Muse 會說明狀況、停止該工作階段儲存，拒收新訊息與設定變更；請重新執行 Muse，開新工作階段。協定回傳 `session_log_lost`，恢復或重連主機已載入的紀錄也會明確拒絕並給指引；其他對話遺失紀錄只影響那一支。若只是移走原檔，Muse 不會重建空檔，移回原處便能恢復儲存。待核准工具仍能收到「允許一次」「本工作階段允許」或「拒絕」並讓回合收尾；察覺紀錄遺失後，會儲存永久規則的選項則被拒絕並說明原因。
body.en: If someone or a sync tool deletes, replaces, or moves a session log while Muse is running, Muse could previously start a new file silently or write into the replacement. ⟦An accountant who finds the ledger swapped out puts down the pen and raises an alarm; only if the original book was merely moved aside can bookkeeping resume once it is returned.⟧ When a log is deleted or replaced, Muse explains what happened, stops saving that session, and refuses new messages and setting changes; run Muse again to start a new session. The protocol returns `session_log_lost`, and resuming or reconnecting to a log still loaded on the host is also explicitly refused with guidance, while a lost log in another conversation affects only that conversation. If the original file was only moved away, Muse will not recreate an empty file, and moving it back resumes saving. A waiting tool can still receive allow once, allow for this session, or reject to finish the turn, while choices that would save a permanent rule after the loss is noticed are refused with an explanation.

items.original:
Over the session protocol, a refusal caused by a session log deleted or replaced outside Muse now carries the error reason `session_log_lost` when resuming, sending or steering a message, compacting, renaming, forking, opening a side chat, leaving, controlling a subagent or workflow, or choosing an approval that saves something for later, so a client can recognize it without matching the message
When a running session's log file or folder is deleted or replaced outside Muse while Muse is saving to it, Muse no longer starts a new log partway through or writes into the replacement. It says the log was deleted or replaced, stops saving that session and refuses new messages and setting changes there; run Muse again to start a new session. A lost log of another conversation, such as a side chat's, stops saving only that conversation. If the log file itself was moved away instead, Muse says so and saving resumes once you move it back
After the session log is deleted or replaced outside Muse, answering an approval with allow once, allow for this session or reject still reaches the waiting tool and the turn finishes; once Muse has noticed the loss, a choice that would save a rule for later is refused and says why
Over the session protocol, resuming a session the host still has loaded after its log was deleted or replaced outside Muse now refuses with a message that says so and how to go on, instead of answering that the session was not found or resuming it as if its log were intact
When you resume a session and its log is deleted or replaced outside Muse before Muse saves anything new to it, Muse now tells you what happened to it instead of quietly starting a new log or writing into the replacement. A session log or folder moved away outside Muse is no longer re-created empty, so moving it back keeps saving in the same place

title.zh-TW: 對話紀錄遺失後各指令給出正確引導且互不牽連
title.en: Commands give clear guidance and stay isolated after a lost session log

body.zh-TW:
紀錄遭外部刪除或替換後，操作指令不該讓你猜發生什麼事。重新命名、改權限或設定、發訊、`/compact`、`/new`、`/clear`、`/fork`、`/side`、倒帶與子代理操作，首次操作即說明紀錄遺失及處理方式；`/export trajectory` 改提示移回原檔，不再建議 `--no-session-log`。

側邊對話紀錄遺失不再擋住目前工作階段（AI 對話的執行單位）發訊、分支或新子代理；`/resume` 切入前也先拒絕，不打斷現有工作。離開遺失紀錄的對話時不再提示可恢復，已送達的 `/goal` 變更不再標成待送。訊號中斷 `muse exec` 時，退出不再追加第二個錯誤或宣稱日誌已刷新。若回合稍早儲存失敗，後續排隊訊息、模型、核准或推理力度變更遭拒，回合末的「session log flush degraded」警告也不再遺漏。
body.en:
When a session log is deleted or replaced externally, commands should not leave you guessing what happened. From the very first action after the loss, renaming, changing permissions or settings, sending a message, `/compact`, `/new`, `/clear`, `/fork`, `/side`, rewinding, and subagent actions all explain that the log is missing and how to proceed; `/export trajectory` now tells you to move the file back instead of suggesting `--no-session-log`.

A missing log in a side chat no longer blocks sending messages, branching, or starting new subagents in your current session; `/resume` also refuses before switching in, so it does not interrupt active work. Leaving a chat with a missing log no longer offers to resume it, and a `/goal` change already received is no longer marked as pending. When a signal stops `muse exec`, exiting no longer appends a second error or claims the logs were flushed. If a save failed earlier in a turn and a later queued message or a model, approval, or reasoning-effort change is refused, the "session log flush degraded" warning at the end of the turn no longer goes missing.

items.original:
After a session log is deleted or replaced outside Muse, renaming the session, changing permissions or a setting, sending a message, `/compact`, `/new`, `/clear`, rewinding, and messaging, following up with, resuming or reopening a subagent from its view say so and what to do instead of a generic or misleading error, from the first thing you do after the deletion; a `/goal` change the running turn already received is no longer shown as still waiting to reach the model; leaving the session over the session protocol says so when its log was replaced; and `muse exec` no longer adds a second error at exit or says it flushed the logs when a signal stops it
When a session log is moved or deleted outside Muse, turn and leave errors over the session protocol and the `muse serve` stop line say so and how to get saving back, `/export trajectory` says the log is missing and to move it back instead of suggesting `--no-session-log`, and `/new` or `/clear` held back by another conversation's moved log names it
After a session log is deleted or replaced outside Muse, `/fork` and `/side` say so and start nothing, even when one is the first thing you do after the deletion; `/resume` into another conversation, such as a side chat, whose log was lost while Muse was saving it alongside this one is refused before it can stop the current conversation's running turn or background work; and when you leave a session whose log was lost, its notice says so and no longer offers to resume it, whether that session did not shut down cleanly or Muse stopped waiting for it to shut down, and the "To continue this session" line that `/clear` and `/new` show for it is removed when that notice appears
When a session log is replaced outside Muse, or deleted on macOS or Linux, while a save to it is still unconfirmed, Muse now says the log was lost instead of reporting a failed flush every time, and another conversation's lost log, such as a side chat's, no longer holds back new messages, `/fork`, `/side` or new subagents in the conversation you are in
The "session log flush degraded" note at the end of a turn no longer goes missing when a queued message or a model, approval or reasoning-effort change was refused once because a save had failed earlier in the turn

title.zh-TW: 對話檢視受損自動從日誌修復並消弭重載競態
title.en: Damaged chat views heal from the log and reload races are resolved

body.zh-TW:
當你恢復一個儲存畫面剛好毀損的對話時，程式以前常卡在重建錯誤直接罷工。⟦拼圖散亂後可以對照盒蓋原圖恢復畫面，現在也能依日誌恢復對話檢視，不再直接卡在重建錯誤。⟧現在恢復對話若遇上檢視資料受損，會自動從日誌修復；不支援重建的分支對話則立即回報 `projectionRebuildFailed`，健康狀態幀也會合併成最終狀態送出一次。

已載入對話若即時檢視失敗關閉，程式會透過註冊表的弱參照從日誌重新載入一次，失敗時只發報一次 `projectionRebuildFailed`；收到 `healthy` 訊號後，用戶端會重讀檢視、採納回合狀態，並跳過已繪製的列。先前在工具串流輸出或回合進行中重載容易撞車報錯的競態問題，也一併修好。
body.en:
Previously, resuming a chat whose saved view happened to be damaged often stalled on a rebuild error. ⟦Scattered puzzle pieces can be rebuilt by checking the picture on the box lid; now a damaged chat view can likewise be restored from the log instead of getting stuck on a rebuild error.⟧ Now, if view data is damaged on resume, it heals automatically from the log; a forked chat that cannot be rebuilt reports `projectionRebuildFailed` right away, and health frames coalesce so only the final state is sent once.

If a loaded chat's live view fails closed, the app reloads it once from the log via a weak registry reference and announces `projectionRebuildFailed` only once on failure; after receiving a `healthy` signal, the client re-reads the view, adopts the turn state, and skips rows it already rendered. Races where reloading during streaming tool output or an active turn could collide and fail are also fixed.

items.original:
A resumed chat whose saved view is damaged heals it from the log; a forked chat, which is not rebuilt, reports `projectionRebuildFailed` right away; health frames coalesce so the client sees the final state once
A loaded chat whose live view fails closed is re-loaded once from its log (weak registry hold, no reopen); a failed re-load announces `projectionRebuildFailed` once
After a `healthy` view-health signal, the client re-reads the view and adopts the turn state, skipping rows it already rendered
Fixed re-loading a chat's failed view while a tool streams output, which could fail with `projectionRebuildFailed`
Fixed a race where re-loading a chat's failed view during a running turn could fail with `projectionRebuildFailed`

title.zh-TW: 當機重開後誠實標記未明工具狀態並支援跨版本接續
title.en: Uncertain tool states are marked honestly after a crash and cross-build resume works

body.zh-TW:
如果程式剛好在工具跑完或執行 `!` 指令的瞬間當機，重開後以前常會直接寫成「成功」或留下一整格空白。⟦猶如停電前一刻遞出的簽收單，復電後帳本不會自作主張寫「已完成」，而是先蓋上「待確認」印章以免誤判。⟧現在當機前剛完成的工具呼叫，恢復後會標註為「unresolved」以示結果未確定；未完成的 `!` 指令改標已取消並加註「可能已執行」，遇到未辨識狀態的恢復指令也不再誤顯示為成功，就算碰到沒記到結果的工具紀錄仍可顯示為未知並繼續對話。

由不同編譯版本儲存的工作階段（AI 對話的執行單位）重開後也能繼續收新提示而不報內部錯誤；但若新版於當機後自動恢復並告知代理曾被中斷，該筆對話須更新程式才能開啟。
body.en:
If the app crashed right as a tool finished or a `!` command was running, reopening used to mark it as succeeded or leave a blank result. ⟦Suppose a delivery slip was handed over right before a blackout: once power returns, the ledger stamps it "pending confirmation" instead of guessing "delivered."⟧ Now, a tool call that finished just before a crash is marked "unresolved" on resume to show its outcome is uncertain; an unfinished `!` command is marked cancelled with a note that it may have run, a resumed command with an unrecognized status no longer shows as succeeded, and a tool record with no recorded outcome still displays as unknown so the chat can continue.

A session saved by one build can also take new prompts when reopened by a differently compiled build without throwing an internal error; however, if a newer build auto-resumed after a crash and told the agent what was interrupted, you must update the app to open that chat.

items.original:
A Muse build older than this release cannot open a chat in which a newer build resumed the session automatically after a crash and told the agent what was interrupted. Updating the app fixes it; other chats are unaffected
A resumed command with an unrecognized result status no longer shows as succeeded
A tool call that finished just before a crash no longer keeps its settled row after resume; the resumed view marks it `— unresolved` so an uncertain outcome is never shown as settled
A session saved by one Muse Code build can take new prompts when a differently compiled build reopens it, instead of failing to send with an internal error
Resumed sessions can continue after an unrecorded tool result, with the outcome shown as unknown
After a crash, a `!` command that had not finished is marked cancelled with a note that it may have run, instead of an empty result

title.zh-TW: 當機與停止背景指令後重開，不再擅自啟動回合
title.en: Reopening after a crash or stopped background command no longer starts a turn on its own

body.zh-TW: 先前遭遇當機或在背景指令還沒跑完時退出程式，等你想起這段對話重新打開時，代理常常二話不說就自己開始回覆，把你剛開好的畫面打亂。⟦彷彿電腦從休眠醒來時先把沒處理完的文件留在桌上，等主人坐回桌前敲下第一句再動手，不會半夜自己開工。⟧現在從當機復原工作階段（AI 對話的執行單位）時，先前排隊的後續追蹤、背景結果與復原結果都會等你的下一則訊息，不再自行啟動回覆。一般重開則是不再為退出時被停止的背景指令擅自開回合；重開後的對話紀錄會將該指令顯示為背景執行中，不附帶完成列。
body.en: Previously, after a crash or quitting while a background command was still running, reopening the chat often caused the agent to start replying unprompted and disrupt your view. ⟦Waking a computer from sleep leaves unfinished papers on the desk until you sit down and type the first line, rather than starting work on its own overnight.⟧ Now, when recovering a session from a crash, queued follow-ups, background results, and restored results wait for your next message instead of starting a reply on their own. On a normal reopen, the agent no longer starts a turn for a background command that quitting had stopped; the reopened transcript shows the command as backgrounded with no finished row.

items.original:
Reopening a session no longer makes the agent start a turn by itself to react to a background command that quitting had stopped. The reopened transcript then shows the command as backgrounded, with no finished row
After a chat reopens from a crash, queued follow-ups and background results now wait for your next message instead of starting a reply on their own
After a crash, reopening a chat in the terminal no longer starts a reply on its own — queued follow-ups and restored results wait for your next message instead

title.zh-TW: 當機後復原終端機迴響並讓待答問題準確作答一次
title.en: Terminal echo is restored after a crash and pending questions answer once

body.zh-TW:
當 Muse 在工作階段（AI 對話的執行單位）進行到一半因磁碟寫滿等記憶體錯誤意外崩潰時，過去終端機會陷入「打字看不見字元」的無迴響狀態，非得手動輸入 `reset` 才能恢復，現在終止時會自動將終端機復原成正常顯示。

針對當機恢復後的待答問題，以前就算前面做過壓縮就答不進去、遇到滿佇列會被丟包、甚至同一題能連答兩次。現在就算早期內容已經壓縮過，當機前在等的提問依然能順利作答；遇到滿佇列時送出的答案會等佇列消化再送出，也不會再讓代理收到兩份重複答案。
body.en:
When Muse crashes mid-session on a memory fault such as a full disk, the terminal used to be left without echo so typed characters were invisible until you ran `reset`; now it automatically restores normal terminal behavior on exit.

For pending questions after a crash resume, earlier compaction used to block answering, a full queue would drop submissions, and the same question could even be answered twice. Now, a question the agent was waiting on before a crash can still be answered even if earlier work was compacted; a submission that meets a full queue waits for it to drain instead of dropping, and the agent can no longer receive duplicate answers.

items.original:
When Muse dies on a memory fault (for example a disk that fills up mid-session), your terminal is put back to normal instead of being left without echo until you run `reset`
Answering a pending question right after a crash resume works again: a submit that meets a full queue waits for the next drain instead of dropping
After resuming a session, a question the agent asked can no longer be answered twice, so the agent gets exactly one answer
After a crash, a question the agent was still waiting on can be answered even when earlier work in the session was compacted

title.zh-TW: 存檔記住核准與 3D 任務編號並修正舊版復原誤判
title.en: Saves record approvals and 3D job IDs while fixing older-session resume bugs

body.zh-TW:
跨重啟或重開舊對話時，以前容易弄丟剛送出的請求狀態，或在連線用戶端上顯示假失敗與過期權限。現在存檔會記下正在套用中的核准與 3D 生成服務已受理的任務 ID，確保重啟後只結算一次或不因中斷遺失任務編號，但含這兩種新紀錄的對話須更新程式才能開啟。

重試重啟復原已捨棄的排隊回合時，會明確回報已捨棄而非看似還在排隊；遺失權限變更紀錄的對話，在恢復將重設時會先顯示重設後層級（無法決定或遭拒時則維持留存層級）。從連線用戶端首次開啟未曾壓縮或曾遇殘留重啟的舊工作階段（AI 對話的執行單位）時，也不再漏掉先前回合或誤報舊的 `runtime_turn_task_lost`。
body.en:
Across restarts or when reopening older chats, recently sent request states could be lost, or a connected client could show stale permissions or false failures. Saved chats now record approvals that are still being applied and job IDs accepted by the 3D generation service, ensuring approvals settle only once after a restart and job IDs are not lost if interrupted; however, chats containing either new record require updating the app to open.

Retrying a queued turn that restart recovery abandoned now reports it as abandoned instead of looking still queued; a chat with a lost permission change shows the reset level when a resume would commit a reset, or keeps the surviving level if the reset cannot be decided or is refused. Opening an older, never-compacted session or one with a leftover restart from a connected client for the first time also no longer drops an earlier turn or reports a stale `runtime_turn_task_lost` failure.

items.original:
Saved chats can now record that an approval is still being applied, so it settles exactly once after a restart; earlier versions can't open a chat that holds this record, and updating fixes it
Saved chats can now record that the 3D generation service accepted a job, so its job ID is not lost if the call is stopped; earlier versions can't open a chat that holds this record, and updating fixes it
Retrying a queued turn that restart recovery abandoned now reports it as abandoned instead of looking still queued
Opening a chat whose saved permission change was lost now shows the reset permission level when a resume would commit a reset, instead of the older, wider level. When the reset is refused or cannot be decided, it keeps showing the surviving level
Resuming an older session from a connected client no longer drops an earlier completed turn from the model's context, or names it as unreadable, when a leftover restart followed it
Opening an older, never-compacted session from a connected client for the first time no longer reports a stale `runtime_turn_task_lost` failure from a leftover restart as its last turn

title.zh-TW: 強化 `session-index.db` 抗損重建並止住無謂暴長
title.en: Harden `session-index.db` against corruption and stop needless growth

body.zh-TW:
多個 `muse serve` 行程共用資料夾時，過去會反覆更新名稱清單、讓預寫日誌暴長；同時重建已刪除的 `session-index.db`（工作階段索引資料庫）也可能漏掉最初寫入。⟦多間分店共用總目錄，以前每隔幾秒就整本重抄、把紙塞爆，現在不再重複抄寫，損壞的目錄也能移開重編。⟧現在多行程並存不再反覆重寫名稱清單與撐大預寫日誌，訂閱清單變更的應用不再每隔幾秒收到假更新，兩個行程同時重建已刪索引也不會漏掉第一批寫入。

macOS 與 Linux 上的損壞索引會自動移開重建，讓 `/resume` 不必等手動刪檔。執行中把別的檔案移覆索引不再導致崩潰，也不會再顯示被換掉的舊索引檔裡的工作階段，但另一程式當下仍開著移入的新檔案時例外；移入更大的索引也不再誤判損毀。
body.en:
When multiple `muse serve` processes shared a data folder, they used to rewrite the session-name list repeatedly and bloat the write-ahead log, while recreating a deleted `session-index.db` simultaneously could drop the first writes. ⟦Branch offices sharing a master directory used to recopy the whole book every few seconds until paper overflowed; now they stop rewriting it needlessly and can set aside a damaged copy to rebuild.⟧ Multiple processes now no longer rewrite the name list or grow the write-ahead log on every pass, subscribers stop receiving false change updates every few seconds, and two processes recreating a deleted index at the same time no longer lose the first batch of writes.

On macOS and Linux, a damaged index is set aside and rebuilt automatically so `/resume` does not wait for manual file removal. Moving another file onto the index while running no longer crashes the app or shows sessions from the replaced file, unless another program has the new file open at that moment; moving a larger index onto it also no longer fails as corrupt.

items.original:
Moving another file onto `session-index.db` while Muse Code runs no longer shows the replaced file's sessions (unless another program has the new file open at that moment) or crashes the app
Moving a larger session index onto `session-index.db` while Muse Code runs no longer leaves the session list failing as a corrupt index
Two Muse Code processes that recreate a deleted session index at the same moment no longer lose one side's first writes
On macOS and Linux, a damaged saved-session index is now set aside and rebuilt automatically, so `/resume` no longer stays slow until the file is removed by hand
Several `muse serve` processes sharing one data folder no longer grow the session index write-ahead log by about one index size every few seconds, which could fill the disk
Several `muse serve` processes sharing one data folder no longer rewrite the session-name list in the session index on every maintenance pass, so session list subscribers stop getting a change notification every few seconds

title.zh-TW: 保住對話自訂名稱與超長首問不被清單漏掉
title.en: Preserve custom chat names and keep huge first prompts in the list

body.zh-TW:
以前開過一場幫它取好名字的對話、或第一則訊息貼進好幾 MB 的除錯日誌，回頭打開 `/resume` 卻常發現名字被重取甚至整筆從清單裡消失。現在只要對話本身的歷史紀錄裡存著名稱，就算名稱清單遺失或在自動命名途中當機，下次開啟仍會沿用原本名稱，讓 `muse resume <name>` 繼續找得到。

同一台機器上就算同時跑著舊版程式，新版開啟的工作階段（AI 對話的執行單位）也不會再從清單憑空消失；第一句就貼上超大型提示的對話同樣會留在清單裡、可正常恢復並接續發問，標題則截取該提示的前 1,000 個字元顯示。
body.en:
Previously, opening `/resume` for a chat you had named—or one whose first message pasted several megabytes of debug logs—often gave it a new automatic name or dropped it from the list altogether. Now, as long as the chat's own history holds its name, it keeps that name on the next start even if the separate name list is lost or a crash happened during automatic naming, so `muse resume <name>` still finds it.

A session started by a newer build no longer disappears from session lists while an older process is still running on the same machine; a chat whose first message is a massive prompt likewise stays in the list, resumes normally, and accepts follow-up prompts, with its title showing the first 1,000 characters of that prompt.

items.original:
A chat keeps the name saved in its own history when you open it, even if Muse's separate list of names has lost it; before, it could get a new automatic name and `muse resume <name>` stopped finding it
After a crash during automatic naming, a chat whose history already holds its name keeps that name on the next start instead of getting a new automatic one
A session started by a newer Muse no longer disappears from session lists while an older Muse process keeps running on the same machine
A session whose first prompt is very large, for example a log file of several megabytes, no longer drops out of the session list in apps that list your sessions, and you can still resume it and send more prompts; the session title shows the first 1,000 characters of that prompt

title.zh-TW: 模型目錄容錯與切換憑證後的清單更新
title.en: Resilient model catalog handling and list updates after switching credentials

body.zh-TW:
換了一組 API 金鑰、切換帳號，或是遇到後端模型目錄一時回傳空清單時，先前介面容易還卡在舊名單或直接罷工。⟦宛如換了會員卡進場或遇到菜單暫時空白，櫃檯不會直接趕人，而是刷新你的專屬選項並在無公開項目時先開出獲准的隱藏款。⟧現在重新啟動 `muse serve` 會確實改列新憑證可用的模型，清單也會過濾掉伺服器未提供的舊存模型；缺少輸出上限的目錄條目一樣會列出、保留上下文視窗做壓縮並套用標準輸出上限。

若目錄服務回傳零個模型，介面會明報抓取失敗而非悄悄清空清單；事先已指定模型的 `muse exec` 則印出通知照跑；連一個可見模型都沒有時，Muse 會改用授權給你的最新隱藏模型並在啟動通知點名，不再卡死在「model catalog has no visible models」。
body.en:
After changing an API key, switching accounts, or hitting a moment when the backend model catalog returned an empty list, the UI used to stay stuck on the old list or stop working. ⟦If you walk up with a new membership card or find the menu temporarily blank, the counter refreshes your eligible options instead of turning you away, and offers an approved off-menu item when nothing public is listed.⟧ Restarting `muse serve` now lists the models available to the new credential and filters out saved models the server does not serve; catalog entries without an output limit still appear in the list, keep their context window for compaction, and use the standard output limit.

If the catalog service returns zero models, the app reports the fetch as failed instead of silently emptying the list, while `muse exec` with a model already chosen prints a notice and still runs; when not a single visible model is listed, Muse starts on the newest hidden model granted to you and names it in a startup notice instead of stopping with "model catalog has no visible models".

items.original:
Model list no longer shows saved models the server does not serve
After you store a different API key or sign in to another account, a restarted `muse serve` lists that credential's models instead of the previous credential's saved model list
When the model catalog service answers with no models, the app now reports the catalog fetch as failed instead of silently emptying the model list
A model whose catalogue entry gives its context window but no output limit now shows in the model list, keeps that window for compaction, and uses the standard output limit
`muse exec` with a model already chosen no longer exits when the model catalog service answers with no models; it prints one notice and runs that model
When the model catalog lists no visible model, Muse now starts on the newest hidden model it grants you and names it in a startup notice, instead of stopping with "model catalog has no visible models"

title.zh-TW: 登入失敗、鎖住鑰匙圈與切換模型提示寫明解法
title.en: Clearer fixes for login failures, locked Keychains, and model switches

body.zh-TW:
遠端登入 Mac 或帳號權限異常時，以前常被一句「API 金鑰無效」或內部代碼搞得一頭霧水，重試好幾輪才發現方向不對。現在在鑰匙圈上鎖的 Mac 上登入，會直接附帶鑰匙圈原生錯誤碼，提醒執行 `security unlock-keychain` 後重啟 Muse Code；若是因為應用遭停用被伺服器拒收登入，面板也會直說原因並提示重新登入無效。

對訂閱戶工作階段（AI 對話的執行單位）而言，登入後模型清單晚一步才到齊不再報「Model not found」；切換模型導致對話無法接續時，也會說明原因並引導開新工作階段就能帶著既有歷史繼續做，不再只丟下一句無法準備對話。
body.en:
During a remote Mac login or an account permission issue, a vague "invalid API key" message or internal code used to send you in circles across retries. Now, signing in on a Mac with a locked Keychain includes the Keychain's own error code and tells you to run `security unlock-keychain` and restart Muse Code; if the server refuses a login because the app is deactivated, the panel states that reason and notes that signing in again will not fix it.

For subscriber sessions, the model list arriving after sign-in no longer fails with "Model not found"; when a model switch makes a chat unable to continue, Muse explains why and guides you to start a new session with your existing history kept instead of only saying the conversation could not be prepared.

items.original:
When the server refuses a login because the Muse Code app is deactivated, the login panel now shows that reason and that signing in again will not fix it, instead of saying the API key is invalid
On a Mac with a locked Keychain, such as over a remote login, signing in now says to run `security unlock-keychain` and restart Muse Code, with the Keychain's own error code, instead of showing only an internal code
After a model switch makes a chat unable to continue, Muse now says why and that starting a new session continues the work with this session's history kept, instead of only saying the turn could not prepare the conversation
Subscriber sessions no longer fail with "Model not found" when the model list arrives after sign-in

title.zh-TW: 改進 /feedback 首次壓縮上傳與缺少金鑰提示
title.en: Improve /feedback First-Launch Compression and Missing-Key Prompts

body.zh-TW:
想在剛裝好程式、還沒連上遠端設定時就透過 `/feedback` 回報問題，或是回報一個龐大的長工作階段（AI 對話的執行單位）紀錄，現在比以前更順暢。`/feedback` 從首次啟動就能直接使用壓縮上傳，容納高達約 760 MiB 的工作階段紀錄，不必等抓取遠端設定。

若因紀錄太長而被迫縮減兩次才塞得進上傳額度，送出後的通知會精準顯示實際送出版本的保留與捨棄大小；當 `/feedback` 或 `/bug` 因缺少 Model API 金鑰無法上傳時，提示也會寫明兩種送出方式：設定一組 Model API 金鑰，或是 Meta 員工改用內部版 Muse。
body.en:
Reporting an issue with `/feedback` right after installing—before remote settings are connected—or sending a large, long session (a unit of AI conversation) record is now smoother than before. From its very first launch, `/feedback` uses compressed uploads that hold up to about 760 MiB of session history without waiting to fetch remote settings.

If a record is too long and must be shortened twice to fit the upload limit, the notice after sending accurately shows the kept and dropped sizes of the version actually sent. When `/feedback` or `/bug` cannot upload because a Model API key is missing, the prompt also spells out two ways to submit: set a Model API key, or, for Meta employees, use the internal Muse build.

items.original:
`/feedback` uses the compressed upload that keeps sessions of up to about 760 MiB from the first launch, without waiting for Muse Code to fetch its remote settings
When `/feedback` has to shorten a long session record twice to fit the upload, the notice after sending now shows the kept and dropped sizes of the record that was actually sent
When /feedback or /bug cannot upload because there is no Model API key, the message now says how to get the report sent: set a Model API key so /feedback can send it, or, as a Meta employee, use the internal Muse build

title.zh-TW: 卡住的託管工作階段改在 30 秒退回可重試錯誤
title.en: Stuck Hosted Sessions Now Return a Retryable Error After 30 Seconds

body.zh-TW:
透過 `muse serve` 操作一個已經卡死的工作階段（AI 對話的執行單位）時，過去送訊息、觸發技能或取消經常毫無音訊、吐出內部錯誤，甚至過一陣子自己偷跑。現在無論是傳文字訊息啟動或引導回合、跑技能或送出取消，只要工作階段卡住無法處理，都會在 30 秒後改回傳可重試的忙碌錯誤；忙碌逾時 30 秒仍未啟動的訊息也會撤回而不事後偷跑。

在操作順序上，允許第一次權限後於 shell 指令跳出第二次詢問時透過協定停掉回合，不再導致後續提示全報「approval replay failed」或卡死排隊；恢復對話後回答待辦結構化提問時，誤觸雜鍵也不會把你的 Enter 靜悄悄吞掉，暫存答案依舊只送出一次。
body.en:
When operating a stuck session through `muse serve`, sending a message, triggering a skill, or canceling used to produce silence, an internal error, or even delayed execution later on. Now, whether you send a text message to start or steer a turn, run a skill, or send a cancel, any stuck session that cannot process commands returns a retryable busy error after 30 seconds. Messages that fail to start within a 30-second busy timeout are also withdrawn so they do not run later.

In terms of operation order, stopping a turn over the protocol when a shell command raises a second permission ask—after you allowed the first one—no longer causes later prompts to fail with "approval replay failed" or stay stuck in a queue. When answering a pending structured prompt after resuming a conversation, hitting a stray key no longer silently swallows your Enter, and the staged answer still sends only once.

items.original:
In `muse serve`, a text message that starts or steers a turn on a stuck session that cannot take more commands now fails after 30 seconds with a busy error you can retry, instead of never answering
In `muse serve`, a message that runs a skill on a stuck session, or a cancel sent to a stuck session that cannot take more commands, now fails after 30 seconds with a busy error you can retry, instead of an internal error (skill) or no answer (cancel)
After a resume, answering a pending structured prompt no longer silently drops your Enter when a stray key lands before the retry sends; the staged answer still sends exactly once
In `muse serve`, when a busy session has not started a message within 30 seconds, the message is now withdrawn with a busy error you can retry, instead of an internal error after which it could still run later
Stopping a turn over the session protocol while a shell command's second permission ask is open, after you allowed the first one, no longer makes every later prompt in that session fail with "approval replay failed" or stay queued

title.zh-TW: 排除工作階段重開、資料夾誤刪與重複報錯
title.en: Fix Session Reopening, Deleted Folders, and Duplicate Errors

body.zh-TW:
進行工作階段（AI 對話的執行單位）的途中萬一工作區資料夾不小心被刪掉，以前接下來每呼叫一個工具都會連環報錯；現在只要重新呼叫工具就會自動復原，不會整場作廢。重開舊版存下來的對話時也重新保留了工作流程工具，遇到不支援的舊版工作流程格式時會改用新工作階段預設的版本，不必再另開新對話。

當兩輪連續遇到一模一樣的一般模型錯誤且中間沒有其他顯示內容時，執行期間也比照恢復後只顯示一次而不洗版；若是因為設定檔有誤導致啟動失敗，錯誤訊息除了指出問題設定，還會順手提醒修好設定後重新啟動 Muse。
body.en:
If the workspace folder is accidentally deleted mid-session, every subsequent tool call used to fail in a chain reaction; now calling a tool again automatically recovers without ruining the whole session. Reopening conversations saved by an older version also preserves the Workflow tool again, falling back to the default version for new sessions when an unsupported legacy workflow format is encountered instead of requiring a new conversation.

When two consecutive turns hit the exact same plain model error with nothing else shown in between, it now displays only once during execution—just as it does after a resume—instead of flooding the screen. If startup fails due to a bad setting, the error message now points out the problematic setting and reminds you to fix it and restart Muse.

items.original:
When the same plain model failure stops two turns back to back with nothing shown between them, it now appears once while the session runs, as it already does after a resume
Resumed sessions keep the Workflow tool again, including sessions saved by an older version; when a session's saved Workflow version can't be used, it uses the version a new session gets instead of asking you to start a new session
When Muse fails to start because of a setting, the error a session shows now also says to fix the setting and start Muse again
A session whose workspace folder was deleted mid-session now recovers on the next tool call instead of failing every tool

title.zh-TW: 上下文壓縮用滿模型實際視窗並為失敗設停損
title.en: Context Compaction Uses Full Model Window and Stops Repeat Failures

body.zh-TW: 長對話聊到貼滿數十張全尺寸截圖、或接近模型容量上限時，先前壓縮會卡死在 512,000 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）上限，失敗後還每送一則訊息就花錢重算摘要。⟦好比打包快裝滿的行李箱，過去卡在固定大小且壓失敗還不斷重試，現在按真實容量計算，連卡兩次就先停手並說清佔位原因。⟧現在壓縮會用到模型真實上下文視窗，保留訊息已佔滿空間時不再白算摘要並點名原因；連續兩次壓縮或存檔失敗即暫停自動壓縮並顯示原因，直到重開或手動 `/compact` 成功為止。超窗自動重試會刪夠多舊訊以容納；無法判斷保留範圍且超限的回合則直接報「could not fit within the model's context window」；塞滿截圖的工作階段（AI 對話的執行單位）仍可恢復，過大停壓亦會明示。
body.en: When a long conversation accumulates dozens of full-size screenshots or nears the model's capacity limit, compaction previously got stuck at a 512,000-token (the text unit AI processes and bills by) ceiling and paid to recompute a summary on every new message after failing. ⟦Packing a nearly full suitcase used to hit a fixed size limit and keep retrying even after failing, whereas now it packs to the real capacity, stops after two consecutive jams, and states what is taking up the room.⟧ Compaction now uses the model's actual context window, skips wasted summarization when kept messages already fill the space, and names the cause. After two consecutive compaction or checkpoint-save failures, automatic compaction pauses and displays the reason until you reopen the chat or a manual `/compact` succeeds. Automatic retries that exceed the window now drop enough older messages to fit, while an oversized turn whose kept range cannot be determined immediately reports "could not fit within the model's context window". Sessions packed with screenshots can still be resumed, and if oversized images stop automatic compaction, the notice explicitly says so.

items.original:
A chat whose compaction keeps failing to save its checkpoint no longer pays for a new summary on every request; after 2 failures in a row Muse stops automatic compaction for that chat, shows one error naming the cause, and tries again when you reopen the chat or a compaction works
Compaction now works up to the model's real context window instead of stopping at 512,000 tokens, and when Muse cannot tell which recent messages a turn must keep and so skips compaction, a turn larger than the context window now fails right away with a clear "could not fit within the model's context window" error instead of being sent for the provider to refuse
When a chat's own messages already fill the space compaction must keep, Muse no longer pays for a summary it would throw away on every request, and the compaction error names the kept messages as the cause
When a long thread goes over the model's context window, the automatic smaller retry now drops enough older messages to fit instead of being refused again
A chat whose automatic compaction keeps failing at the context limit no longer pays for a new summary on every request; after 2 failures in a row, Muse stops automatic compaction for that chat until a compaction works or you reopen it, and `/compact` still works
A session whose recent turns hold many full-size images, such as dozens of screenshots, can still be resumed after its context fills up; before, the compaction that followed could leave the session impossible to resume. If automatic compaction stops because those images make the compacted context too big to save, the stop notice now says so

title.zh-TW: 背景自動壓縮準時安裝且不再白做工或重複觸發
title.en: Background Auto-Compaction Installs on Time Without Wasted Work

body.zh-TW: 背景自動壓縮原本是為了不讓你乾等，但先前在 `muse serve` 裡碰到軟上限提前起跑的背景摘要，常因為撞上正在執行的回合就被丟掉，結果到硬上限還是得卡住等。⟦彷彿接力賽跑者在隊友衝線前就先把新接力棒備在線邊，過去撞上空檔就整支作廢，現在等這一圈跑完立刻遞上，下一圈直接接著衝。⟧現在內部回合或下一回合進行中完成的背景摘要，會留待回合結束再安裝；首回合補填工作階段（AI 對話的執行單位）名稱等背景細節不再拉低估計空間造成提早壓縮；剛完成壓縮或背景任務回覆後也不會再多跑一次多餘的自動壓縮；壓縮完後你送出的第一則新訊息更能正確接續該份摘要，不再重做摘要又漏掉最近一輪對話。
body.en: Background auto-compaction is meant to keep you from waiting, yet in `muse serve`, background summaries triggered early at the soft threshold were often discarded when they collided with an active turn, leaving you stuck waiting at the hard threshold anyway. ⟦A relay runner prepares a fresh baton at the exchange line before a teammate finishes the lap; previously any timing clash scrapped the baton, but now it waits until the lap ends and hands off immediately for the next leg.⟧ Background summaries that finish during an internal turn or while the next turn is running now wait until that turn ends before installing. Filling in background details like the session name after the first reply no longer skews the space estimate to trigger early compaction, and the app no longer runs a needless extra auto-compaction right after a compaction or a background task's reply. Your first new message after a background compaction finishes also properly builds on that summary instead of re-summarizing and dropping the latest turn.

items.original:
A chat no longer compacts early just because a background detail such as its session name was filled in after the first reply; the context-size estimate now counts only what actually changed
A background compaction summary that finishes while an internal turn is already running now installs after that turn ends, instead of mid-turn where its checkpoint was refused
The TUI no longer occasionally runs one needless extra auto-compaction right after a compaction that happened during a reply, in a reopened session, or after a background task's reply
In `muse serve`, a background compaction started at the soft context threshold is now applied instead of being thrown away, so served sessions usually compact in the background instead of waiting on a blocking compaction at the hard threshold
In `muse serve`, a background compaction whose summary finishes while the next turn is running is now applied when that turn ends, instead of being discarded when that turn starts its own compaction
The first message you send after an automatic compaction finishes in the background now builds on its summary, instead of requesting another summary and dropping the recent turn that summary kept

title.zh-TW: 修好 /compact 長對話凍結並持續顯示壓縮進度
title.en: Fix /compact Freeze in Long Sessions and Keep Progress Visible

body.zh-TW: 在已經有儲存檢查點的長工作階段（AI 對話的執行單位）裡手動輸入 `/compact`，以前常讓整個終端機畫面卡死好幾十秒，最後還跳出一句「no compactable run is available」失敗收場。現在這個凍結錯誤已經修好，執行 `/compact` 準備摘要的整個過程也會穩穩保留進度指示器。不論你是重新開啟對話、恢復工作階段，還是剛從側邊對話切回主對話，畫面上的壓縮進度與狀態都不會再半途消失。
body.en: Manually running `/compact` in a long session with a saved checkpoint used to freeze the terminal for tens of seconds before failing with "no compactable run is available". That freeze bug is now fixed, and the progress indicator stays steadily visible throughout the entire time `/compact` prepares the summary. Whether you reopen a conversation, resume a session, or switch back to the main chat from a side chat, the compaction progress and status no longer disappear partway through.

items.original:
Running /compact in a long session with a saved context checkpoint no longer freezes the terminal for tens of seconds and then fails with "no compactable run is available"
Running `/compact` keeps its progress indicator visible while the summary is being prepared
Keep compaction progress visible in reopened sessions
Keep the compaction status visible after resuming a session
Keep the compaction status visible after returning from a side chat

title.zh-TW: 壓縮檢查點瘦身，避免數千輪後膨脹到存不進去
title.en: Slim Down Compaction Checkpoints to Prevent Save Failures After Thousands of Turns

body.zh-TW: 用 `muse exec` 反覆接續同一個工作階段（AI 對話的執行單位）跑自動化腳本時，對話拉長到幾千次提問後常會突然寫檔失敗、卡在半途。⟦猶如長途旅行時錢包只留目前有效的證件與近照，不再把前幾千天的每張發票全塞進夾層，拉鍊才不會撐爆。⟧現在檢查點只保留對話中還留著訊息的提示接收紀錄、已被摘要取代的紀錄會直接卸除，也不再逐筆累積每次恢復的啟動紀錄與所有歷史工具核准（僅留待審、全工作階段權限與現存工具呼叫）。壓縮檢查點亦改以不附帶回答全文的精簡格式存已答問題與核准選擇，含此格式之對話須更新新版才能開啟。
body.en: When running automated scripts by repeatedly resuming the same session with `muse exec`, conversations stretching to thousands of prompts used to suddenly fail to save and stall partway through. ⟦On a long trip, a traveler's wallet keeps only valid IDs and recent photos instead of stuffing thousands of days' worth of receipts into every slot so the zipper does not burst.⟧ Checkpoints now keep prompt intake records only for messages still present in the conversation, dropping records already replaced by summaries, and stop accumulating start records from every resume or full histories of past tool approvals (keeping only pending ones, session-wide permissions, and existing tool calls). Compaction checkpoints also store answered questions and approval choices in a compact format without full answer text, so chats using this format require a compatible app update to open.

items.original:
Compaction checkpoints keep answered questions and approval choices in a smaller form that holds no answer text; chats whose checkpoint holds one require a compatible app update, and older versions cannot open them
A session resumed thousands of times, for example by repeated `exec` runs, no longer saves every resume's start records in each checkpoint, which had made its checkpoints too large to save
A long session no longer saves every past prompt's intake records in each checkpoint, only those whose message the saved conversation still holds, so checkpoints of sessions with thousands of turns stay small enough to save
A long session no longer saves the approval history of every past tool call in each checkpoint, only approvals still pending, approvals that grant a session-wide permission, and those whose tool call the saved conversation still holds, so checkpoints of approval-heavy sessions stay small enough to save
A long `muse exec` session that resumes for every prompt no longer stops saving its checkpoints after a few thousand prompts, because every session now drops the records of prompts that the conversation summary has already replaced
A `muse exec` session that resumes for every prompt no longer adds a record per prompt to every saved checkpoint, which made such sessions stop saving checkpoints after a few thousand prompts

title.zh-TW: 修復各種中斷與落後情境下的檢查點存檔
title.en: Fix Checkpoint Saving Across Interruptions and Lagging Views

body.zh-TW: 存檔時畫面慢半拍、回合紀錄對不上，或程式被中斷，都曾讓工作階段（AI 對話的執行單位）的壓縮檢查點存不下來。儲存檢視暫時落後時，現在仍會寫入檢查點，下次開啟才追平或從檢查點重建檢視。即時回合紀錄與已存歷史不符，或上次程式在一批工具執行中、尚在儲存時被停止，重開後也能繼續存壓縮檢查點，不再反覆失敗，仍可從最新壓縮恢復。儲存下一個檢查點也會保留原本的復原狀態。就算恢復工作階段的第一回合剛好撞上定時排程任務觸發，該回合的檢查點也能照常存下來而不跳過。
body.en: Lagging saved views, mismatched turn records, or process interruptions used to prevent sessions from saving compaction checkpoints. When the saved view is momentarily behind, the checkpoint is still written now, and the view catches up or rebuilds from it on the next open. Sessions whose live turn record does not match saved history, or whose previous process stopped mid-batch of tool calls or while still saving, can also keep saving compaction checkpoints after reopening instead of failing repeatedly, and still resume from the latest compaction. Saving the next checkpoint also preserves the existing recovery state. Even when a scheduled job fires right as a resumed session's first turn begins, that turn's checkpoints are saved normally instead of being skipped.

items.original:
A compaction no longer leaves its checkpoint unwritten when the saved chat view is momentarily behind; the checkpoint is saved and the view catches up or is rebuilt from it the next time the chat is opened
A session whose saved history no longer matched its live record of a turn now keeps saving compaction checkpoints instead of failing every attempt until a restart, so it still resumes from its latest compaction
Preserve session recovery state when saving the next checkpoint
A session reopened after the previous process stopped in the middle of a batch of tool calls now keeps saving compaction checkpoints instead of failing every attempt, so it still resumes from its latest compaction
A session reopened after the previous run was stopped while still saving now keeps saving compaction checkpoints instead of failing every one until the next restart
A resumed session whose scheduled job fires as its first turn starts now saves that turn's compaction checkpoints instead of skipping them

title.zh-TW: 防範壓縮與背景任務撞車弄壞日誌或卡死回合
title.en: Prevent Compaction and Background Task Collisions From Corrupting Logs or Blocking Turns

body.zh-TW:
當對話正在進行壓縮時，如果背景任務或工作流程也正好在同一時間完工寫檔，以前常把紀錄檔搞成無法讀取的「MalformedJsonl」，或讓後續每回合都報出「event id … conflicts with an existing event」。現在這類同時發生的衝突都已排除，即便子代理剛從磁碟錯誤恢復寫入，或是工具結果只存進執行狀態而沒進工作階段（AI 對話的執行單位）日誌，都不再跳過壓縮檢查點。

檢查點亦會記下外部前綴長度以免復原序號檢查誤拒；遇到儲存空間異常導致定期儲存失敗時，會記明原因並略過而不中斷當前回合，清除舊歷史失敗的儲存也仍算儲存成功。
body.en:
When a background task or workflow finished and wrote to disk at the exact moment a conversation was compacting, it used to corrupt the log into an unreadable "MalformedJsonl" or make every later turn fail with "event id … conflicts with an existing event". These concurrent collisions are now eliminated, and compaction checkpoints are no longer skipped even when a subagent has just recovered from a disk write error or when a tool result was saved to the run state without entering the session log.

Checkpoints also record their foreign-prefix length so recovery ordinal checks do not falsely reject them. When a periodic save fails due to a storage issue, the failure reason is noted and the save is skipped without interrupting the current turn, and a save whose older-history cleanup fails still counts as saved.

items.original:
A session no longer becomes unreadable ("MalformedJsonl") after it compacts its context while a turn and a background task's follow-up are running at the same time
A checkpoint records its foreign-prefix length, so resume of a log with foreign lines below the checkpoint no longer refuses on the ordinal check
A background task or workflow that finishes during a turn that compacts its context no longer makes every later turn fail with "event id … conflicts with an existing event"
A hosted session no longer skips a compaction checkpoint after a subagent's write to the same session file recovers from a disk error
A periodic context save that fails, for example on a storage error, no longer ends the turn; the save is skipped with a note of why and the turn goes on, and a save whose cleanup of older history fails still counts as saved
A compaction no longer skips its checkpoint when a tool result was saved to the run but not to the session log

title.zh-TW: 壓縮對話的預覽與往上翻頁一致停在摘要分隔線
title.en: Keep Compacted Chat Previews and Page-Back Consistent at the Summary

body.zh-TW:
看壓縮過的長對話時，`/resume` 預覽與實際內容曾對不起來，往回翻頁也可能翻出壓縮前的舊紀錄。⟦小說前幾章已收成前情提要，翻到書籤就該停下，不再把收起的草稿整疊拉出。⟧現在恢復預覽會顯示開啟後同樣的近期對話；透過工作階段（AI 對話的執行單位）協定往回翻，會停在單一早期對話摘要，更早的游標會回報檢視已截斷。

一般舊版壓縮工作階段要先讀取，翻頁才會停在摘要；新回合後仍可能顯示舊歷史，須再次讀取。`muse serve` 則已修好更多情境：檢視重建後從第一頁就停在摘要；舊版壓縮對話讀取後新增回合仍會停住，恢復後在第一頁前新增回合也一樣，即使伺服器啟動後從未恢復或讀取過也能停在摘要。
body.en:
When viewing a long compacted conversation, the `/resume` preview used to mismatch the actual content, and paging back could pull up old pre-compaction history. ⟦Once earlier chapters of a novel have been condensed into a recap, flipping back should stop at the bookmark instead of pulling out the whole stack of tucked-away drafts.⟧ The resume preview now shows the same recent conversation you see after opening, and paging back over the session protocol stops at a single earlier-conversation summary while older cursors report that the view was truncated.

Standard sessions compacted under an older version still need to be read first for paging to stop at the summary, and old history may still appear after a new turn until read again. `muse serve` fixes more cases: paging stops at the summary from the first page after a view rebuild, keeps stopping there after a new turn once an older-compacted chat has been read, does the same after a resume even when a new turn lands before the first page, and stops at the summary even if the session was never resumed or read since the server started.

items.original:
The resume picker preview of a long, compacted chat shows its recent conversation, the same history you see after resuming
Paging back through a compacted chat over the session protocol now ends at one earlier-conversation item, as reading the chat does, and an older cursor before it answers that the view was truncated
Paging back through a session that was compacted under an older version now stops at the earlier-conversation summary once the session has been read, as reading it does, instead of showing the history from before the compaction; after a new turn, that history can still appear until the session is read again
Paging back through a compacted `muse serve` chat now stops at the earlier-conversation summary from the first page when its view was rebuilt, and for a chat compacted under an older version it keeps stopping there after a new turn once the session has been read
Paging back through a `muse serve` chat compacted under an older version now stops at the earlier-conversation summary from the first page after a resume, even when a new turn lands before that page
Paging back through a `muse serve` chat compacted under an older version now stops at the earlier-conversation summary even when the session was never resumed or read since the server started, instead of showing the history from before the compaction

title.zh-TW: 託管檢視落後或損毀時自動從壓縮點重建並消除假警告
title.en: Rebuild lagging or damaged hosted views from compaction points and clear false warnings

body.zh-TW:
透過 `muse serve` 開啟存檔檢視落後、無法讀取或只剩結尾標記的壓縮對話時，以前常得重讀整份長日誌甚至開不起來。現在 `muse serve` 會在下次開啟時直接從最新壓縮點重建檢視，把先前內容收進「earlier conversation restored from checkpoint」分隔線後，壓縮點前缺損的紀錄不再阻礙開啟，就算壓縮點之後的紀錄也受損，仍會從最新一則訊息開聊。

舊版經定期歷史檢查點精簡或略過壓縮的對話，往回翻頁時一樣會在早期摘要處停下；成功執行一次或兩次以上 `/compact` 後恢復工作階段（AI 對話的執行單位），也不再誤跳中斷通知或「runtime closed before context compaction completed」假警告。
body.en:
When opening a compacted chat in `muse serve` whose saved view fell behind, is unreadable, or was left as a terminal marker, it used to re-read the entire long log or fail to open. Now `muse serve` rebuilds the view from the latest compaction point on the next open and collapses earlier history behind the "earlier conversation restored from checkpoint" divider. Missing or damaged records before the compaction point no longer block opening, and even if records after it are damaged, the chat still opens from its newest message.

Chats condensed by an older version's periodic history checkpoint or a skipped-checkpoint compaction now also stop at the earlier-conversation summary when paging back. Resuming a session (the execution unit of an AI conversation) after one, two, or more successful `/compact` runs no longer triggers a false interruption notice or the "runtime closed before context compaction completed" warning.

items.original:
A `muse serve` chat whose saved view fell behind its latest compaction now rebuilds that view from the compaction point when it is next opened, instead of re-reading the whole session log; earlier history shows collapsed behind the "earlier conversation restored from checkpoint" divider. If the records after the compaction point are damaged, the chat still opens and keeps working, starting from its newest message instead of refusing to resume
A `muse serve` chat that was compacted and has an unusable saved view (unreadable, or left as a terminal marker) now builds that view from its latest compaction point when it is next opened, instead of re-reading the whole session log; earlier history shows collapsed behind the "earlier conversation restored from checkpoint" divider, and records missing or damaged before the compaction point no longer stop the chat from opening
Resuming after successful context compaction no longer shows a false interruption warning
Paging back through a `muse serve` chat saved by an older version now also stops at the earlier-conversation summary when that chat was condensed by a periodic history checkpoint, or by a compaction whose checkpoint was skipped, instead of showing the history from before the checkpoint
Resuming a session after two or more successful `/compact` runs no longer shows a false "runtime closed before context compaction completed" warning

title.zh-TW: 收回最後一回合後，壓縮與恢復不再重現舊訊息
title.en: Compacting and resuming no longer bring back old messages after taking back the last turn

body.zh-TW: 剛存好進度就抽回上一輪發問時，以前重開或分支可能無法載入，甚至又看見已收回的內容。最後一回合先儲存檢查點但未壓縮，之後又被收回，恢復或分支現在會從前次壓縮接續，不再拒絕載入或重播全部日誌；舊版存檔在同樣條件下恢復也適用。恢復最後一回合已收回的壓縮對話，會顯示最近一次壓縮之後的內容，不再重播整份日誌或顯示被收回回合的摘要。透過工作階段（AI 對話的執行單位）協定重讀或恢復壓縮對話，也不再保留已收回回合帶回的舊訊息。若最新壓縮屬於已收回回合，讀取仍會被拒絕；從早期歷史呼叫 `view/subscribe` 也回同樣錯誤，不再給出原地打轉的游標。
body.en: Taking back your last prompt right after saving progress used to prevent reopening or forking, or even bring back taken-back content. When the last turn saves a checkpoint without compacting and is then taken back, resuming or forking now continues from the previous compaction instead of refusing to load or replaying the whole log, including for older saved chats under the same condition. Resuming a compacted chat whose last turn was taken back shows everything since the last compaction rather than replaying the full log or showing the taken-back turn's summary. Rereading or resuming a compacted chat over the session protocol also stops keeping old messages restored by a taken-back turn. If the latest compaction belongs to a taken-back turn, reading is still refused, and calling `view/subscribe` from earlier history returns the same error instead of a cursor that loops in place.

items.original:
Over the session protocol, a reread or resumed compacted chat no longer keeps showing restored earlier messages from a turn that was taken back
Resuming a compacted session whose last turn was taken back now shows the conversation since the last compaction, as the other clients do, instead of replaying the whole log or showing the taken-back turn's summary
`view/subscribe` from earlier history of a session whose latest compaction belonged to a turn that was taken back now refuses with the same error as reading the session, instead of pointing the client at a cursor that gives the same answer again
Resuming or forking a session whose last turn was taken back after it saved a checkpoint without compacting now continues from the previous compaction, instead of refusing the session or replaying the whole log
Resuming a session saved by an older version whose last turn was taken back after it wrote a checkpoint without compacting now continues from the previous compaction instead of refusing the session

title.zh-TW: 檢查點出現缺漏或損毀紀錄時，盡力救回並引導匯出
title.en: Recover what is possible on missing or damaged checkpoint records and guide export

body.zh-TW:
遭遇異常斷線讓壓縮紀錄殘缺不全時，以前常整段對話直接死鎖、一條錯誤訊息卡死再也進不去。傳送或恢復工作階段（AI 對話的執行單位）時，不再因「projection failed: tool-result clear entry did not match」而失敗。起因是某筆「tool-result clear」清理紀錄找不到對應結果，或對應到不只一個結果；程式現在會略過壞掉的那筆，保留舊輸出繼續。

壓縮中途斷掉留下一大疊殘餘紀錄，重開時也不再因此失敗；若檢查點上方有紀錄遺失，恢復後會把權限重設回預設值並跳出警告，讓你仍能打開對話而非被鎖在門外。唯一例外是當最新檢查點屬於已取消的回合時，為免錯載更早歷史，程式會明確拒絕恢復、讀取或分支，並引導改用 `muse export` 救回日誌。
body.en:
When an unexpected disconnect left compaction records incomplete, a whole chat used to deadlock behind a single error. Sending or resuming a session no longer fails with "projection failed: tool-result clear entry did not match". This happened when a "tool-result clear" cleanup entry matched no result or more than one; the app now skips the broken entry and keeps going with the old output left in place.

Reopening after an interrupted compaction with large leftover records no longer fails either. If a record above a checkpoint is lost, resuming resets permissions to defaults and shows a warning so you can still open the chat instead of being locked out. The only exception is when the newest checkpoint belongs to a cancelled turn: to avoid reloading earlier history by mistake, resuming, reading, or forking is refused with a clear error guiding you to recover the log with `muse export`.

items.original:
A chat whose newest compaction checkpoint belongs to a cancelled turn now refuses to resume, read, or fork with a clear error instead of reloading history from before the checkpoint; use `muse export` to recover its log
Sending or resuming a session no longer fails with "projection failed: tool-result clear entry did not match" when a stored clear record matches no result or matches more than one; the bad entry is skipped and the session continues with the old output left in context
Resuming a chat with a lost record above a checkpoint reopens with permissions reset to defaults and a warning instead of refusing
Resuming a session after an interrupted compaction no longer fails when the leftover compaction records are large

title.zh-TW: 壓縮對話重開後保留圖片提問且不重跑舊佇列
title.en: Keep image prompts and avoid re-running old queued messages after reopening compacted chats

body.zh-TW: 以前在壓縮過的對話裡重開視窗或貼上截圖繼續問問題，常發生兩個意外：要嘛已經跑完的排隊舊訊息莫名再執行一次，要嘛剛發的圖片提問剛好撞上回合開頭壓縮而被丟掉，結果代理跑去回答上一題。現在重開壓縮工作階段（AI 對話的執行單位）後，已完成的排隊訊息不會再重跑；夾帶圖片的提問在回合開頭觸發壓縮時也不會遺失，代理會確實回答該張圖片的問題。重開後才補送的圖片提問，在下次再重開時亦能繼續留在模型上下文裡並支援 `/compact`，只是暫時還不能倒帶或從該回合開分支。
body.en: Reopening a compacted chat or pasting a screenshot to ask a follow-up used to cause two surprises: completed queued messages would run again, or a new image prompt would be dropped when compaction hit at the start of its turn, leaving the agent to answer the previous question. Now, reopening a compacted session no longer re-runs completed queued messages, and an image prompt is no longer lost when compaction triggers at the start of its turn, so the agent answers that image prompt. An image prompt sent after reopening also stays in the model's context on the next reopen and supports `/compact`, though you cannot yet rewind to that turn or fork from it.

items.original:
Reopening a compacted conversation no longer runs completed queued messages again
In a compacted session, an image prompt that you send after you reopen the session now stays in the model's context after the next reopen, and `/compact` works again in that session; you cannot yet rewind to that turn or fork from it
A prompt with an image is no longer dropped when the context is compacted at the start of its turn, so the agent answers that prompt instead of the previous one

title.zh-TW: 修好分支對話重開、檢查點起跑與卡片顯示
title.en: Fix forked chat reopening, checkpoint startup, and card display

body.zh-TW:
把一段長對話開出分支或側邊討論來做實驗，以前重開分支後常得每輪重讀全部歷史，遇上舊紀錄破損、日誌重播錯誤或 "invalid_target" 就整支打不開，甚至要退出時還跳出還有工作在跑的假警告。現在分支本身壓縮過後，重開與再開子分支／側邊對話都會直接從最新檢查點起跑而不受舊紀錄損傷阻礙；補追存過檢查點的對話開分支與側邊對話也不再報 "invalid_target"。

恢復分支工作階段（AI 對話的執行單位）時，日誌重播錯誤與退出時的假工作警告都已消除，先前執行過的指令也會維持收合整齊的「Ran commands」卡片，不再炸出整頁原始輸出。
body.en:
When branching a long chat or opening a side chat to experiment, reopening a fork used to re-read its entire history on every turn, failing to open on damaged older records, log-replay errors, or "invalid_target", or even showing a false active-work warning on quit. Now, once a fork has compacted, reopening it or starting a sub-fork or side chat from it starts directly from its newest checkpoint without being blocked by older damage. Forking or opening a side chat from a session that saved a checkpoint while catching up also no longer fails with "invalid_target".

Resuming a forked session eliminates those log-replay errors and false active-work warnings on quit, and previously run commands stay grouped in the neat "Ran commands" card instead of dumping raw output across the page.

items.original:
A fork reopened after it compacted no longer re-reads its whole history each turn, so damage in older history no longer stops it
Resuming a forked session no longer sometimes fails with a log-replay error that forced a recovery session instead
Resumed forked sessions keep the grouped Ran commands card instead of expanded raw output
A fork or side chat of a fork that has compacted starts from that fork's newest checkpoint instead of re-reading its whole history
Forking a session, or opening a side chat from it, no longer fails with "invalid_target" when the session compacted and later saved a checkpoint while catching up
Avoid a false active work warning when quitting a resumed fork

title.zh-TW: 分支建立前先驗種子合法性並補全複製訊息
title.en: Validate fork seeds before creation and restore missing copied messages

body.zh-TW:
先前剛壓縮完、還沒發新訊息就急著開分支，常因為檢查點計算方式落差被誤判為種子數量不符，或者好不容易開出一個分支卻怎麼都打不開。現在檢查點夾帶的分支種子與接續壓縮對話的乾淨分支，都已對齊重播規則，不再無故被拒；分支或側邊對話剛壓縮完、尚未送出下一則訊息時，再從它開分支也不再出現種子數量不符。

反過來說，如果原對話裡藏著沒記到開頭的空回合，或生成的種子在其他地方無法載入，建立分支當下就會直接攔下並說明原因，不會先建好才讓你打不開。透過工作階段（AI 對話的執行單位）協定讀取分支或倒帶對話時，一回合開頭連發的多則訊息、夾圖片訊息與回合進行中補送的訊息也全數補回顯示。
body.en:
Forking right after compaction before sending a new message used to fail with a fork seed count mismatch due to checkpoint counting differences, or produce a fork that refused to open. Checkpoint-carried fork seeds and clean successor forks of compacted chats are now aligned with replay rules and no longer rejected without cause. Branching from a forked or side chat right after it compacts, before its next message, also no longer triggers a seed count mismatch.

Conversely, if the original chat contains an empty turn whose start was never recorded, or a seed that would fail to load elsewhere, fork creation now stops immediately and explains why instead of creating an unopenable fork. Reading a forked or rewound chat over the session protocol also restores all previously missing messages in copied turns: multiple messages sent at the start of a turn, messages with images, and messages sent while the original turn was still running.

items.original:
Checkpoint-carried fork seeds the loader must accept are no longer refused as mismatched: covered turns and carrier children count the way the replay mints them
A clean successor fork of a compacted session (its summary flattened ahead of the model's answer) is no longer counted as a mismatched seed: the answered summary is its context run, not a turn
Reading a forked or rewound conversation over the session protocol now shows the messages you sent in its copied turns that were missing before: each message of a turn that began with several, a message with an image, and a message you sent while the original turn was still working
Forking a chat that contains an empty turn whose start was not recorded is now refused with a message saying why, instead of creating a fork that fails to open
A fork whose seed would fail to load elsewhere is now refused at creation with a clear error instead of publishing and then failing to open
Branching a forked or side session right after it compacts, before its next message, no longer fails with a fork seed count mismatch

title.zh-TW: /rewind 倒帶確認加上立即回饋與窄視窗防誤按
title.en: Add instant feedback and short-terminal safeguards to /rewind confirmation

body.zh-TW: 在比較矮小的終端機視窗按 `/rewind` 確認倒帶時，過去在伺服器還沒回話前畫面看似毫無動靜，選項太擠看不見甚至按 Enter 就糊裡糊塗送出了。⟦就跟按下行車記錄器的回溯鍵一樣，面板立刻亮起「準備中」，選項不再顯示選取反白，視窗太矮還會提醒拉高，不再對著靜止畫面誤按。⟧現在確認倒帶會馬上顯示「Preparing rewind…」並取消選項反白。準備期間按下 `Ctrl-D` 或自訂離開鍵也能觸發「press again to quit」提示，若有任務仍在跑則彈出退出確認，選 Stay 或 Esc 可退回倒帶畫面。短視窗下一定會留住警告與所選動作並擋下畫不出的隱藏選項確認，太矮則請你拉高；若倒帶啟動前遭拒，畫面也會清楚寫明原因而不靜默跳回選單。
body.en: Confirming `/rewind` in a short terminal window used to leave the screen looking frozen before the server answered, hiding cramped options or even confirming unseen ones on Enter. ⟦Pressing a dashcam's rewind button lights up a "preparing" indicator right away, clears the row highlights, and asks you to make the screen taller if it is too short, so you never confirm blindly on a static menu.⟧ Confirming a rewind now shows "Preparing rewind…" immediately and clears the row selection. While it prepares, pressing `Ctrl-D` or your remapped exit key triggers the "press again to quit" hint, and if work is still running, the exit confirmation appears where Stay or Esc returns to the rewind screen. Short terminals always keep the warnings and selected action visible while blocking Enter on hidden actions, or ask you to make the window taller if nothing fits; if a rewind is refused before starting, the screen explains why instead of silently returning to the menu.

items.original:
Confirming a conversation rewind now shows "Preparing rewind…" right away, and the action rows stop showing a selection, so it is clear the rewind is underway before the server answers
In a short terminal, the rewind confirmation keeps its warnings and the selected action on screen, Enter no longer confirms an action the screen could not show, and a terminal too short for any action asks you to make it taller
While a confirmed conversation rewind is preparing, the exit key (Ctrl-D, or your remapped exit binding) works again: the first press shows the "press again to quit" hint on the rewind screen, and when work is still running the exit confirmation appears and Stay or Esc returns to the rewind
When a conversation rewind is refused before it starts (the command queue is full or closed, the request fails, or the server rejects it), the rewind screen now shows why instead of returning to its choices with no message

title.zh-TW: 分支對話支援倒帶，並釐清壓縮邊界與讀圖失敗提示
title.en: Support /rewind in forked chats and clarify compaction boundaries and image-read errors

body.zh-TW:
在從主線切出來的分支對話裡想用 `/rewind` 回到某一步時，過去常碰上不支援的限制，或是碰到舊對話壓縮點、壞圖檔時看到誤導人的選項與提示。現在分支對話已經正式支援倒帶，無論是要退回從原對話複製過來的訊息，還是分支之後新加進去的訊息都能照常操作。

在摘要無法作為分支起點的舊版工作階段（AI 對話的執行單位）中，`/rewind` 不再列出壓縮摘要之前的時間點，摘要之後的點則標為無法使用；若要倒帶的回合裡夾帶了一張無法讀取的貼上圖片，程式也會明確提示圖片讀不到且可重試，不再誤報為「對話已經變更」。
body.en:
Using `/rewind` inside a forked chat used to hit unsupported limits or show misleading options and errors around old compaction points or broken images. Rewind now works in forked conversations for both messages copied from the original chat and new messages added after the fork.

In older sessions whose summary cannot start a branch, `/rewind` no longer offers points from before the compacted summary, and points after it are shown as unavailable. When rewinding to a turn with an unreadable pasted image, the app now clearly states that the image could not be read and that you can retry, instead of falsely reporting that the conversation changed.

items.original:
`/rewind` no longer offers points from before a compacted summary in older sessions whose summary cannot start a branch; the points after it are shown as unavailable instead
Rewind works in forked conversations, including copied messages and new messages added after the fork
Rewinding to a turn whose pasted image can't be read now says the image couldn't be read and that you can retry, instead of saying the conversation changed

title.zh-TW: 終端機支援自動切換深淺主題與更寬的比較表格
title.en: Support automatic light-dark terminal themes and wider comparison tables

body.zh-TW: 盯著終端機從白天寫到黑夜，以前切了系統背景顏色介面卻不動，白底文字偏淡，多項數字還硬拆成窄表。⟦猶如隨屋外陽光自動調色的變色眼鏡，終端機切換深淺色時介面不用重開就同步換裝，白底上的字跡與框線也跟著加深。⟧在 Ghostty、kitty 與 Contour 等終端機裡，除非於 `/theme` 固定背景，否則主題會即時同步，預設淺色主題亦調深次要、成功、警告、強調與邊框色彩。比較多筆短數字時改為單張寬表格。輸入 `/hud` 可於底部狀態列顯示與 `/status` 相同的工作階段（AI 對話的執行單位）ID。在恢復對話的選單裡按 `ctrl+o` 進舒適檢視時，會點名工作區未信任、探測沙盒不可用或檢查失敗等狀態缺席原因。預設的緊湊檢視不變。新 TUI 亦補回「You're using your quota fast」額度提醒。
body.en: Coding in a terminal from day into night used to leave the UI static when your system background changed, with pale text on white and multi-item numbers split into narrow tables. ⟦Photochromic lenses tint automatically with outdoor sunlight; here, the UI switches themes live as your terminal changes between light and dark without a restart, while text and borders on white grow darker.⟧ In terminals such as Ghostty, kitty, and Contour, the theme now syncs live unless you pin a fixed background in `/theme`, and the Default Light theme darkens secondary, success, warning, accent, and stroke colors. Comparing multiple short numbers now renders in one wider table. Running `/hud` shows the same session ID in the bottom status bar as `/status`. Pressing `ctrl+o` for the comfortable view in the resume picker now names why workspace status is unavailable—such as an untrusted workspace, unavailable probe sandbox, or failed check—while the default dense view stays unchanged. The new TUI client also restores the "You're using your quota fast" quota prompt.

items.original:
`/hud` can show the current session ID in the bottom status bar, the same ID `/status` reports
The resume picker's comfortable view (`ctrl+o`) now explains why workspace status is unavailable — whether the workspace is not trusted, the probe sandbox is unavailable, or the status check failed — instead of silently omitting it; the default dense view is unchanged
When an answer compares many items on short numbers, such as estimates for several funds under several scenarios, Muse can now show them in one wider table that still fits a normal terminal instead of splitting them into narrow tables
